words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: The cat jumped into the box.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳进了盒子里。
words.en: If you go into a place or thing, you move from the outside to the inside of it.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之后；
adv. 以后；后来；
words.ex: I will call you after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我晚饭后给你打电话。
words.en: In addition to its use as a preposition meaning 'behind in place or time,' 'after' can also function as an adverb to indicate a subsequent time or event.

words.ex: He slept during the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他在看电影时睡着了。
words.en: Throughout the course or duration of (a period of time).

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.ex_cn: 他把球朝窗户扔去。
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.tr: prep. 反对；与…相反；倚着；违反；碰；对着；
words.ex: He spoke against the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: In opposition to; contrary to; in contact with.

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。
words.en: If something is for a particular person, group, or purpose, it is intended to be used by that person or group or for that purpose.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.ex: He is among the best students in class.
words.ex_cn: 他是班上最好的学生之一。
words.en: If you are among a group of things or people, you are surrounded by them or part of them.

words.tr:
adv. 如此；这么；很；也
conj. 所以
words.ex: I am so tired after school.
words.ex_cn: 我放学后非常累。
words.en: used to emphasize the degree or extent of something

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他从未去过日本。
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.ex_cn: 他放学后常常去公园。
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他终于完成了作业。
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.ex_cn: 船离开了岸边。
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: I can't find my keys anywhere.
words.ex_cn: 我在任何地方都找不到我的钥匙。
words.en: in, at, or to any place, when it does not matter where

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.ex: He almost finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎完成了作业。
words.en: You use almost to indicate that something is not completely the case but is nearly the case.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.ex_cn: 瓶子里没有水。
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.tr: adv. 曾经；在任何时候；总是；
words.ex: Have you ever been to Paris?
words.ex_cn: 你曾经去过巴黎吗？
words.en: At any time; always; in any case; used for emphasis when you are comparing things.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.ex_cn: 今天很冷。
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.tr:
prep. 沿着；
adv. 沿着；
words.ex: We walked along the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们沿着河走。
words.en: If you move or look along something such as a road, you move or look towards one end of it.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr:
prep. 在…周围；环绕；
adv. 大约；到处；在附近；环绕；
words.ex: The children are running around the tree.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在树周围跑。
words.en: In a position or direction surrounding, or in the vicinity of, a particular place or thing.

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.ex_cn: 我有时走路去学校。
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.tr:
adv. 更加；
adj. 更多的；
pron. 更多的人或物；
words.ex: She wants to learn more about science.
words.ex_cn: 她想更深入了解科学。
words.en: You use 'more' to indicate that there is a greater amount of something than before or than average, or than something else. You can use 'more' with a noun to indicate that there is a greater amount of it than before or than average, or than something else.

words.ex: He will probably come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能来参加派对。
words.en: Used to say that something is likely to be true or likely to happen.

words.ex: He will arrive soon.
words.ex_cn: 他很快就会到。
words.en: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

words.ex: We work together every day.
words.ex_cn: 我们每天一起工作。
words.en: If people do something together, they do it with each other.

words.ex: I saw him two days ago.
words.ex_cn: 我两天前见过他。
words.en: If something happened a particular length of time ago, it is that length of time since it happened.

words.tr: adv. 到处；处处；各个地方；所有地方；
words.ex: She looked everywhere for her keys.
words.ex_cn: 她到处找她的钥匙。
words.en: in or to all places

words.tr:
adv. 另外；其他；
adj. 别的；其他的；
words.ex: I want tea, else coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我想喝茶，另外也想喝咖啡。
words.en: In addition to what has already been mentioned or considered.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.ex_cn: 他远离了房子。
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.tr:
adv. 非常；很；
adj. 恰好是；正是；
words.ex: He is very happy today.
words.ex_cn: 他今天非常开心。
words.en: Used to emphasize the degree or extent of something.

words.ex: I left my keys somewhere in the house.
words.ex_cn: 我把钥匙落在房子的某个地方了。
words.en: In or to some place.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐只吃苹果。
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他仍然在等公交车。
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: He has already finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他已经完成了他的作业。
words.en: You use already to say that something has happened, or that something had happened before the moment you are referring to.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
words.en: In a good or satisfactory manner; in a thorough manner; in a manner that is appropriate or suitable.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他甚至连再见都没说。
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: He is not happy.
words.ex_cn: 他不开心。
words.en: Used to make a negative statement or to negate a verb, adjective, or other adverb.

words.tr:
conj. 一旦；一…便；
adv. 曾经；一次；
words.ex: Once you finish your homework, you can play.
words.ex_cn: 一旦你完成作业，就可以玩了。
words.en: At one time in the past; formerly.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.ex: The coffee is too hot to drink.
words.ex_cn: 这咖啡太热了，没法喝。
words.en: In addition; also; more than is desirable, permissible, or possible; excessively or extremely.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我确信他明天会来。
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.ex: He seldom eats fast food.
words.ex_cn: 他很少吃快餐。
words.en: If something seldom happens, it happens only occasionally.

words.tr:
adv. 出去；外出；离开；
v. 揭露；使熄灭；驱逐；
prep. 向外；在外面；
adj. 出局的；外面的；
words.ex: He walked out of the room.
words.ex_cn: 他走出了房间。
words.en: If someone is out, they are not at home or not at their usual place of work. If something is out, it is not in its usual place. If you are out of something, you no longer have any of it. If something is out, it is available to the public. If a light or fire is out, it is no longer burning or shining. If a ball in a game is out, it is outside the area where it should be. If a secret is out, it is known by people who were not supposed to know it. If you are out, you are no longer involved in a competition or activity because you have been defeated or have decided to stop.

words.tr: adv. 然而；不过；不论到什么程度；无论如何；
words.ex: I like coffee; however, I drink tea in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢咖啡；然而，我早上喝茶。
words.en: You use however when you are adding a comment which is surprising or which contrasts with what has just been said.

words.ex: How do you make coffee?
words.ex_cn: 你如何煮咖啡？
words.en: In what way or manner; by what means.

words.ex: Why did you come late?
words.ex_cn: 你为什么来晚了？
words.en: You use why in questions when you ask about the reasons for something.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.ex: She cleaned the room herself.
words.ex_cn: 她自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when the female subject of the verb is also the object.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: This book is hers.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是她的。
words.en: used to refer to something belonging to or associated with a female person or animal previously mentioned

words.ex: Somebody left their umbrella here.
words.ex_cn: 某人把伞落在这里了。
words.en: Somebody refers to a person who is not known or not specifically named.

words.ex: He is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的兄弟。
words.en: used to refer to a man, boy, or male animal previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: You can eat anything you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你喜欢的东西。
words.en: Any object, event, fact, etc., that is not specified or known.

words.ex: Its color is blue.
words.ex_cn: 它的颜色是蓝色的。
words.en: Belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: pron. 无论什么；任何事物；
words.ex: You can eat whatever you want.
words.ex_cn: 你可以吃任何你想吃的东西。
words.en: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type; used especially when you are indicating that you do not know or care which specific thing is being referred to.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.ex: You should believe in yourself.
words.ex_cn: 你应该相信自己。
words.en: Used to refer to the person being addressed as the object of a verb or preposition when they are also the subject of the clause.

words.ex: I need something to eat.
words.ex_cn: 我需要吃点东西。
words.en: Some thing or things that are not specified or known.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.tr:
pron. 我（主语）
n. 碘（元素iodine的符号）
words.ex: I am going to the store.
words.ex_cn: 我要去商店。
words.en: The first person singular pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to himself or herself.

words.ex: He cleaned the room himself.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自打扫了房间。
words.en: used as the object of a verb or preposition when the male subject of the verb is also the object

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr: pron. 他们自己；她们自己；它们自己；
words.ex: The children cleaned the room themselves.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们自己打扫了房间。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a group of people or things previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.ex: Everyone likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: You use everyone or everybody to refer to all the people in a particular group.

words.ex: Does anybody know the answer?
words.ex_cn: 有人知道答案吗？
words.en: Any person at all; anyone.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.tr:
pron. 这个；
adj. 这；
adv. 这样；这个；这么；
words.ex: This is my book.
words.ex_cn: 这是我的书。
words.en: You use 'this' to refer to a person or thing that is near you, especially when you touch them or point to them.

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.ex_cn: 他把书给了我。
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.ex: This is her book.
words.ex_cn: 这是她的书。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a female person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: Is this your book?
words.ex_cn: 这是你的书吗？
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他们的书在桌子上。
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: My book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used to refer to oneself as the possessor of something.

words.ex: Our dog sleeps on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 我们的狗睡在地板上。
words.en: Belonging to or associated with the speaker and one or more other people previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
adj. 每个的；各自的；
pron. 每个；各自；
words.ex: Each student has a book.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都有一本书。
words.en: Used to refer to every one of a group or series considered individually.

words.ex: The dog licked itself.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔了自己。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to a thing or animal previously mentioned as the subject of the clause.

words.tr:
pron. 我的（东西）；
n. 矿；
v. 采矿；
words.ex: This book is mine.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我的。
words.en: Used to refer to a thing or things belonging to or associated with the speaker. A place where minerals are extracted from the earth. To extract minerals from the earth.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我们布置了一次测验。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself and one or more other people as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: His book is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他的书在桌子上。
words.en: Used to refer to a male person or animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: Anyone can learn to read.
words.ex_cn: 任何人都能学会阅读。
words.en: Any person at all; it does not matter who.

words.ex: It is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 它在桌子上。
words.en: used to refer to a thing previously mentioned or easily identified

words.ex: Whom did you invite to the party?
words.ex_cn: 你邀请了谁来参加派对？
words.en: You use whom in questions when you ask about the name or identity of a person or group of people.

words.tr: pron. 这些；“this”的复数； adj. 这些的；
words.ex: These books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在桌子上。
words.en: You use these at the beginning of noun groups to refer to someone or something that you have already mentioned or identified.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.ex_cn: 那个女孩是谁？
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.ex: Nobody knows the answer.
words.ex_cn: 没有人知道答案。
words.en: Nobody means not any person or no person.

words.ex: We cleaned the house ourselves.
words.ex_cn: 我们自己打扫了房子。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition when this is the same as the subject of the clause and the subject is the speaker and one or more other people considered together.

words.ex: This book is ours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是我们的人或物。
words.en: You use ours to refer to something that belongs or relates both to yourself and to one or more other people.

words.tr:
pron. 没有什么；
n. 无关紧要的事；
words.ex: I have nothing to say.
words.ex_cn: 我没什么可说的。
words.en: Nothing means not anything or no single thing.

words.ex: I did it myself.
words.ex_cn: 我自己做的。
words.en: Used by a speaker to refer to himself or herself as the object of a verb or preposition when he or she is the subject of the clause.

words.ex: They are playing soccer in the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们在公园里踢足球。
words.en: You use they to refer to a group of people, animals, or things.

words.ex: She is reading a book.
words.ex_cn: 她正在读书。
words.en: used to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.ex: What is your name?
words.ex_cn: 你叫什么名字？
words.en: You use 'what' in questions when you ask for specific information about something that you do not know.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.ex_cn: 我们正在吃午饭。
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 那些书在桌子上。
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.tr:
adj. 又一个的；另一个的；
pron. 又一；另一；
words.ex: I need another cup of tea.
words.ex_cn: 我需要又一杯茶。
words.en: used to refer to an additional person or thing of the same type as one already mentioned or known about.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.ex_cn: 你想读哪本书？
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.ex: You are my best friend.
words.ex_cn: 你是我最好的朋友。
words.en: Used to refer to the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.ex: I saw him yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我昨天看见他了。
words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.ex: This book is yours.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是你的。
words.en: Used to refer to something belonging to or associated with the person or people that the speaker is addressing.

words.tr:
adj. 两者的；
pron. 两者；
conj. 不仅…而且...；
words.ex: Both books are on the table.
words.ex_cn: 这两本书都在桌子上。
words.en: You use both to refer to two things or people together.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他犯了这样的大错。
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.tr:
v. 是；动词be的第一人称单数现在式
abbr. 上午；“ante meridiem”的缩写
words.ex: I am happy today.
words.ex_cn: 我今天很开心。
words.en: first person singular present of be

words.ex: She is happy.
words.ex_cn: 她很高兴。
words.en: Used with a third person singular subject to indicate identity, condition, or existence.

words.ex: They are happy.
words.ex_cn: 他们很高兴。
words.en: Are is the second person singular and plural, and first and third person plural of the present tense of 'be'.

words.ex: The caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
words.ex_cn: 毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
words.en: To begin to be something or to develop into something.

words.ex: The temperature remains high during summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天温度保持很高。
words.en: If someone or something remains in a particular state or condition, they stay in that state or condition and do not change.

words.ex: He seems tired after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后似乎很累。
words.en: If something seems to be a particular way, it appears to be that way.

words.tr:
art. 一（个）
n. 英文字母表的第一个字母
words.ex: A cat is on the table.
words.ex_cn: 一只猫在桌子上。
words.en: Used before nouns to refer to a single thing or person that has not been mentioned before.

words.tr: art. 一个 （在下一单词为元音开头时代替“a”）
words.ex: I saw an apple on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我看到桌子上有一个苹果。
words.en: Used before a word that begins with a vowel sound.

words.ex: This is the book I bought.
words.ex_cn: 这是我自己买的那本书。
words.en: used to refer to a specific person or thing that has already been mentioned or is known about

words.tr: v. 遗弃；抛弃；“abandon”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 被遗弃了的；
words.ex: They abandoned the old car by the road.
words.ex_cn: 他们把那辆旧车遗弃在路边。
words.en: Left behind or deserted; given up.

words.tr: v. 吸收；“absorb”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The sponge absorbed the water quickly.
words.ex_cn: 海绵很快吸收了水。
words.en: If you are absorbed in something, you are very interested in it and your attention is fully occupied by it.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: The teacher said the answer is acceptable.
words.ex_cn: 老师说这个答案是可以接受的。
words.en: Something that is acceptable is satisfactory or good enough to be allowed or approved of.

words.tr: adj. 技艺高超的；完成的；熟练的； v. 完成；实现；“accomplish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is an accomplished pianist.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位技艺高超的钢琴家。
words.en: If someone is accomplished at something, they are very skilled at it.

words.ex: Graduating with honors was her greatest accomplishment.
words.ex_cn: 以优异成绩毕业是她最大的成就。
words.en: Something that has been achieved successfully.

words.ex: He was late, so he left accordingly.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，于是相应地提前出发了。
words.en: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances.

words.tr: v. 解释说明；“account”的现在分词； n. 会计；会计学；
words.ex: He is accounting for his absence.
words.ex_cn: 他正在解释他的缺席。
words.en: Accounting is the process of keeping financial accounts.

words.ex: He is an activist who helps the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位帮助穷人的积极分子。
words.en: An activist is a person who works to bring about political or social change by campaigning, public speaking, or demonstrating.

words.ex: The actual cost was lower than expected.
words.ex_cn: 实际成本比预期的低。
words.en: You use actual to emphasize that you are referring to something real or genuine.

words.tr: v. 加；增加；“add”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 附加的；增加的；更多的；
words.ex: He added two and three to get five.
words.ex_cn: 他把二和三相加得到五。
words.en: Added means extra or additional.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: The administrator fixed the computer system.
words.ex_cn: 管理人员修复了计算机系统。
words.en: An administrator is a person whose job involves helping to organize and supervise the way that an organization or institution functions.

words.tr: adj. 先进的；高级的； v. 提前；前进；“advance”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This school uses advanced technology in classrooms.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校在教室里使用先进的技术。
words.en: An advanced system, method, or design is modern and has been developed from an earlier version of the same thing.

words.ex: He is an adviser to the government.
words.ex_cn: 他是政府的顾问。
words.en: An adviser is a person who gives advice, especially someone who knows a lot about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 晾干；通风；公开；公开讨论；散步；兜风
v. （使）通风；播出；晾干；“air”的现在分词
words.ex: The clothes are on the line for airing.
words.ex_cn: 衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: The act of exposing something to the air, especially to freshen or dry it, or the broadcasting of a program on radio or television.

words.tr:
adj. 警觉的；警惕的；
n. 警报；
v. （使）警惕；（使）戒备；
words.ex: The alert guard noticed the strange movement.
words.ex_cn: 这位警觉的警卫注意到了奇怪的动静。
words.en: If you are alert, you are paying full attention to things around you and are able to deal with anything that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 吃惊的；惊奇的； v. 使惊奇；使吃惊；“amaze”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: I was amazed by the magic show.
words.ex_cn: 我对这场魔术表演感到吃惊。
words.en: If you are amazed by something, you are very surprised by it.

words.ex: The school made an announcement about the holiday.
words.ex_cn: 学校发布了关于假期的通告。
words.en: A public or formal notice about something that has happened or is going to happen.

words.ex: The loud noise was an annoyance to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 那阵噪音让每个人都感到烦恼。
words.en: Annoyance is the feeling of being slightly angry or impatient.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的； v. “annoy”的现在分词；
words.ex: The loud noise is annoying.
words.ex_cn: 这噪音很讨厌。
words.en: Something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

words.tr: adv. 每年地；一年一次地；
words.ex: He visits his parents annually.
words.ex_cn: 他每年去看望他的父母。
words.en: Happening once every year.

words.tr: adj. 引起兴趣的； v. 吸引；“appeal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book has an appealing story.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有一个引人入胜的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as appealing, you mean that you like them or they make you want to have or do something.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.tr:
n. 阿拉伯语；
adj. 阿拉伯（语）的；
words.ex: He speaks Arabic fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说阿拉伯语。
words.en: Relating to the Arabs or their language, culture, or civilization.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.ex: He is an artistic boy who loves to draw.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢画画的艺术型男孩。
words.en: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

words.ex: The museum displayed many beautiful artworks.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆展出了许多精美的艺术品。
words.en: Artwork refers to the pieces of art that are produced by artists, including paintings, sculptures, and other forms of visual art.

words.tr: adj. 有关联的；相关的；联合的； v. 联想；联合；“associate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are associated with each other.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是有关联的。
words.en: If one thing is associated with another, the two things are connected in some way.

words.tr: v. 使惊讶；“astonish”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was astonished by the sudden news.
words.ex_cn: 他被这个突然的消息惊呆了。
words.en: If you are astonished by something, you are very surprised about it.

words.ex: His attendance at the meeting was mandatory.
words.ex_cn: 他必须出席这次会议。
words.en: The act of being present at a place or event.

words.ex: The old painting was sold at an auction.
words.ex_cn: 那幅旧画在拍卖会上被卖出了。
words.en: An auction is a public sale where goods or property are sold to the highest bidder.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.tr: n. 航空；航空学；飞行（术）；
words.ex: He works in aviation as a pilot.
words.ex_cn: 他作为一名飞行员从事航空工作。
words.en: Aviation is the operation and production of aircraft.

words.ex: He has awareness of the environmental problems.
words.ex_cn: 他意识到环境问题。
words.en: Knowledge or perception of a situation or fact.

words.tr:
n. 后台；
adv. 在后台；
words.ex: The actors waited backstage before the show.
words.ex_cn: 演员们在演出前在后台等候。
words.en: Behind the scenes in a theater or relating to the private lives of people in the entertainment industry.

words.ex: The children play in the backyard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在后院玩耍。
words.en: A backyard is an area of land at the back of a house, often used for recreation or gardening.

words.ex: He basically just wants to be left alone.
words.ex_cn: 他基本上只是想一个人待着。
words.en: You use basically to indicate that you are stating a fact or opinion in a simple, clear, or definite way.

words.tr: v. 用水清洗（尤指身体部位）；给…洗澡，游泳( bathe的过去式和过去分词 )；
words.ex: He bathed his hands in warm water.
words.ex_cn: 他用温水清洗了双手。
words.en: To wash oneself or someone else in a bath or shower.

words.ex: The soldiers walked across the battlefield.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们走过战场。
words.en: A battlefield is a place where a battle is fought.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.tr: adj. 被踩实的； v. “beat”的过去分词；
words.ex: The beaten path through the forest was easy to walk on.
words.ex_cn: 穿过森林的被踩实的小路很容易走。
words.en: If someone is beaten in a game, competition, election, or battle, they are defeated by their opponents.

words.ex: She danced beautifully at the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对上漂亮地跳舞。
words.en: In a way that is pleasing to the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.tr: n. 就寝时间；睡觉时间；
words.ex: His bedtime is 9 p.m. every night.
words.ex_cn: 他的就寝时间是每天晚上9点。
words.en: The time when someone usually goes to bed.

words.tr: n. 开头；开端； v. 开始；着手；“begin”的现在分词；
words.ex: The beginning of the story is very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事的开头非常精彩。
words.en: The point in time or space at which something starts.

words.tr: v. 属于；“belong”的现在分词； n. 所有物；物品；行李；
words.ex: This book belongs to me.
words.ex_cn: 这本书属于我。
words.en: A feeling of being happy or comfortable as part of a particular group and having a good relationship with the other members of the group because they welcome you and accept you.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.ex: He felt deep pain from his friend's betrayal.
words.ex_cn: 他因朋友的背叛感到深深的痛苦。
words.en: The action of betraying one's country, a group, or a person; treachery.

words.ex: The bidder won the auction with the highest offer.
words.ex_cn: 这位出价者以最高出价赢得了拍卖。
words.en: A bidder is a person or organization that offers to pay a particular amount of money for something that is being sold.

words.ex: The biologist studies animals in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生物学家在森林里研究动物。
words.en: A biologist is a scientist who studies living organisms and their relationship to their environment.

words.tr: n. 幸事； v. “bless”的现在分词；
words.ex: Finding a good job after graduation was a blessing.
words.ex_cn: 毕业后找到一份好工作是一件幸事。
words.en: A blessing is a prayer asking for God's favor and protection, or a beneficial thing for which one is grateful.

words.tr:
n. （果树的）花朵；
v. 开花；
words.ex: The apple tree is full of blossom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，苹果树上开满了花。
words.en: When a tree or plant blossoms, it produces flowers before producing fruit that can be eaten.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.ex: He felt a bodily pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他感到身体疼痛。
words.en: Relating to the human body.

words.ex: He felt boredom during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: Boredom is the state of feeling bored.

words.tr:
adj. 专横的；爱发号施令的
n. 母牛或小牛
words.ex: She is bossy and tells others what to do.
words.ex_cn: 她很专横，总是告诉别人该做什么。
words.en: If you describe someone as bossy, you mean that they enjoy telling people what to do.

words.tr: adj. 瓶装的； v. “bottle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He drank bottled water during the hike.
words.ex_cn: 他在徒步时喝了瓶装水。
words.en: Adjective. Contained or stored in a bottle.

words.ex: Nike is a famous brand.
words.ex_cn: 耐克是一个著名品牌。
words.en: A brand is a name, term, design, symbol, or any other feature that identifies one seller's good or service as distinct from those of other sellers.

words.tr: n. 崩溃；故障；细目分类；
words.ex: The stress led to a breakdown.
words.ex_cn: 压力导致了崩溃。
words.en: A breakdown is a failure of a system, machine, or relationship, or a sudden collapse in someone's mental health.

words.ex: He carries a briefcase to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带着公文包去上班。
words.en: A briefcase is a flat, rectangular container with a handle, used especially for carrying papers and documents.

words.tr: n. （无线电和电视的）节目制作和播放； v. “broadcast”的现在分词；
words.ex: The company works in broadcasting TV shows.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从事电视节目的制作和播放。
words.en: The transmission of programs or information by radio or television.

words.ex: Reading books can broaden your mind.
words.ex_cn: 读书可以扩大你的视野。
words.en: If something broadens or if you broaden it, it increases in size or range.

words.ex: The trees bud in spring.
words.ex_cn: 树木在春天发芽。
words.en: A bud is a small pointed lump that appears on a tree or plant and develops into a leaf or flower.

words.tr: v. 燃烧；“burn”的现在分词； adj. 燃烧的；强烈的；
words.ex: The wood is burning in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 木头正在壁炉里燃烧。
words.en: A burning issue or problem is very important and needs to be dealt with immediately.

words.ex: The calculation took only five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这个计算只花了五分钟。
words.en: The process of using mathematics to find a number or amount.

words.ex: The camper parked near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 露营车停在湖边。
words.en: A camper is someone who stays in a tent or a caravan, especially for a holiday.

words.tr: n. 露营； v. “camp”的现在分词；
words.ex: Camping in the mountains is fun.
words.ex_cn: 在山上露营很有趣。
words.en: Camping is the activity of staying in a tent on holiday.

words.tr:
v. 记录；准确地描述；俘虏；吸引；
n. 抓捕；
words.ex: The camera can capture the moment clearly.
words.ex_cn: 相机可以清晰地记录下这一瞬间。
words.en: To capture someone or something means to catch them, especially after a chase.

words.ex: They shouted, 'Welcome home!' when he walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 当他走进门时，他们大喊：‘欢迎回家！’
words.en: A greeting used to express pleasure at someone's return to their home.

words.tr: n. 照顾者；护理者；看护者
words.ex: The caregiver helps the old man every day.
words.ex_cn: 这位照护者每天帮助这位老人。
words.en: A caregiver is someone who is responsible for looking after another person, especially a family member who is sick, elderly, or disabled.

words.tr: adj. 关心的；有同情心的；
words.ex: She is a caring teacher who helps her students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位关心学生的老师。
words.en: If someone is caring, they are affectionate, helpful, and sympathetic.

words.tr: n. 捕手，捕捉者；接球手
words.ex: The catcher caught the ball with one hand.
words.ex_cn: 接球手用一只手接住了球。
words.en: A catcher is someone or something that catches, especially in baseball, the player who stands behind home plate and catches the pitches thrown by the pitcher.

words.tr: v. 满足需要；“cater”的现在分词； n. 包办饮食；
words.ex: The new service is catering to the needs of students.
words.ex_cn: 这项新服务正在满足学生的需求。
words.en: The business of providing food and drink for events or occasions.

words.tr: adj. 著名的； v. 庆祝；“celebrate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is a celebrated painter in China.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位在中国著名的画家。
words.en: A celebrated person or thing is famous and much admired.

words.tr:
v. 追逐；
n. 追逐；
words.ex: The dog chases the cat every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这只狗每天早上追逐猫。
words.en: To chase someone or something means to quickly follow them or it in order to catch them.

words.ex: She gave a cheerful smile.
words.ex_cn: 她露出了快乐的微笑。
words.en: Someone who is cheerful is happy and shows this in their behavior.

words.ex: He ate a cherry from the bowl.
words.ex_cn: 他从碗里吃了一颗樱桃。
words.en: A cherry is a small, round fruit that is typically bright or dark red. It is often eaten fresh or used in cooking and baking.

words.tr: n. 儿童托管；儿童保育；
words.ex: She works in childcare for young children.
words.ex_cn: 她从事幼儿托管工作。
words.en: The care of children, especially by a service or organization.

words.ex: He remembers his childhood as a happy time.
words.ex_cn: 他记得自己的童年是一段快乐的时光。
words.en: Childhood is the period of a person's life when they are a child.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.ex: He listens to classical music every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上听古典音乐。
words.en: Classical refers to music, literature, or art that is considered to be of the highest quality and of lasting value, especially from the ancient Greek or Roman periods or from the 18th and early 19th centuries.

words.tr: v. 清除；“clear”的现在分词； n. 空旷地；
words.ex: They are clearing the leaves from the yard.
words.ex_cn: 他们正在清除院子里的树叶。
words.en: A clearing is an open area in a forest where there are no trees or bushes.

words.ex: He explained the problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 他清楚地解释了这个问题。
words.en: In a way that is easy to see, hear, read, or understand.

words.tr: n. 攀爬；爬升； v. 攀爬；爬升；“climb”的现在分词；
words.ex: Climbing is his favorite outdoor activity.
words.ex_cn: 攀爬是他最喜欢的户外活动。
words.en: Climbing is the activity of climbing up something, especially mountains or rocks, often as a sport or hobby.

words.tr: adj. 关闭的；保密的； v. 关闭；“close”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The store is closed on Sundays.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店星期天关门。
words.en: If something is closed, it is not open or available to the public.

words.tr: v. 关闭；使接近；“close”的现在分词； n. 关闭；倒闭；
words.ex: He is closing the door slowly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在慢慢关上门。
words.en: The act of shutting or finishing something.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；攫住
n. 紧抓；离合器；一窝雏；一小群；紧要关头
words.ex: He clutched the rope tightly when he slipped.
words.ex_cn: 当他滑倒时，他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To clutch something means to hold it tightly, usually because you are afraid or anxious. In a vehicle, the clutch is a pedal that you press with your foot to change gears.

words.ex: The coastal village has beautiful beaches.
words.ex_cn: 这个沿海村庄有美丽的海滩。
words.en: relating to the coast, the area where the land meets the sea

words.tr: n. 共同执笔者；合著者；
words.ex: He is the coauthor of the science book.
words.ex_cn: 他是这本科学书籍的共同执笔者。
words.en: A coauthor is a person who works with another person or other people to write a book, article, or report.

words.ex: The scientist created a cocktail of chemicals for the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 科学家为实验配制了一种化学混合物。
words.en: A cocktail is a mixed drink typically made with a combination of alcoholic beverages and other ingredients such as fruit juices, syrups, or cream.

words.tr: n. 代码；编码；行为准则；密码；法典；
words.ex: He wrote a simple code to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一段简单的代码来解决这个数学问题。
words.en: A code is a system of words, letters, figures, or other symbols substituted for other words, letters, etc., especially for the purposes of secrecy. As a verb, it means to convert (a message or other information) into a code.

words.ex: The two companies worked together in collaboration.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司通过合作一起工作。
words.en: the act of working together with someone to produce or create something

words.ex: My colleague helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A colleague is someone you work with, especially in a professional job.

words.tr: adj. 五彩缤纷的；丰富多彩的；
words.ex: The children painted a colorful picture of the rainbow.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们画了一幅五彩缤纷的彩虹画。
words.en: Something that is colorful has bright colors or a lot of different colors.

words.ex: The lock uses a simple combination of three numbers.
words.ex_cn: 这个锁使用三个数字的简单组合。
words.en: A combination is a mixture of things or people that are combined.

words.tr: n. 喜剧演员；滑稽人物；
words.ex: The comedian made everyone laugh with his jokes.
words.ex_cn: 这位喜剧演员用他的笑话逗得大家大笑。
words.en: A comedian is a person whose job is to make people laugh by telling jokes or funny stories.

words.tr:
adj. 令人安慰的
v. 安慰；“comfort”的现在分词
words.ex: The news was comforting to those who had been worried.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息对那些一直担心的人来说是一种安慰。
words.en: Making you feel less sad or worried; giving comfort.

words.ex: He commonly eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他一般在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: If something is commonly the case, it is usually or often the case.

words.ex: This is a commonplace event in big cities.
words.ex_cn: 这在大城市里是件普通的事。
words.en: Something that is commonplace is ordinary and not very interesting.

words.ex: She showed compassion for the homeless man.
words.ex_cn: 她对那个无家可归的人表示同情。
words.en: Compassion is a feeling of pity, sympathy, and understanding for someone who is suffering.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: He completely forgot his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他完全忘记了钥匙。
words.en: In a way that is whole or entire; to the fullest extent.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.tr: v. 集中；浓缩；“concentrate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 浓缩的；密集的；全神贯注的；
words.ex: He concentrated on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他专心做作业。
words.en: If something is concentrated, it has been made stronger or purer by removing or reducing the amount of other substances in it.

words.tr: adj. 担心的；关注的； v. 涉及到；“concern”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: My parents are concerned about my grades.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母对我的成绩感到担心。
words.en: If you are concerned about something, you are worried about it.

words.tr: adj. 有条件的，习惯于…的
words.ex: He is conditioned to wake up early.
words.ex_cn: 他已经习惯于早起。
words.en: If someone is conditioned to do something, they have been influenced in such a way that they do it automatically or without thinking about it.

words.tr: v. 证实；确认；“confirm”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 证实的；
words.ex: The test confirmed his illness.
words.ex_cn: 检测证实了他生病了。
words.en: If someone is confirmed in a particular position or role, they are formally given that position or role.

words.tr: adj. 相冲突的；相矛盾的；不一致的； v. “conflict”的现在分词；
words.ex: The two stories are conflicting.
words.ex_cn: 这两个故事是相互冲突的。
words.en: If beliefs, needs, or facts, etc. conflict, they are very different and cannot easily exist together or both be true.

words.ex: He looked at me with confusion.
words.ex_cn: 他困惑地看着我。
words.en: A state of uncertainty about what is happening, intended, or required.

words.ex: People congregate in the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 人们在周末聚集在公园里。
words.en: To congregate means to come together in a group or crowd.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；连接的； v. 连接；“connect”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The two events are connected.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件是相关的。
words.en: If one thing is connected with another, there is a link or relationship between them.

words.ex: He has a considerable amount of money.
words.ex_cn: 他有相当多的钱。
words.en: Considerable means large in size, amount, or extent.

words.ex: He is constantly checking his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不断地查看他的手机。
words.en: If something happens constantly, it happens all the time or very often.

words.tr: adj. 传染性的；有感染力的；
words.ex: The flu is contagious and spreads easily.
words.ex_cn: 流感具有传染性，容易传播。
words.en: A contagious disease can be caught by touching someone who has the disease or by touching an infected object or by breathing in infected air.

words.ex: She put the apples in a plastic container.
words.ex_cn: 她把苹果放进了一个塑料容器里。
words.en: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

words.tr: adj. 欧洲大陆的；大陆的；
words.ex: He prefers continental breakfast with bread and coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢欧洲大陆式的早餐，有面包和咖啡。
words.en: Continental is used to describe something that relates to or is characteristic of a continent, especially the mainland of Europe as distinct from the British Isles.

words.ex: The contraction of the muscle helps you move your arm.
words.ex_cn: 肌肉的收缩帮助你移动手臂。
words.en: A contraction is a process of becoming smaller or shorter, or a word that is made shorter by leaving out some letters.

words.ex: The controller turns the machine on and off.
words.ex_cn: 控制者打开和关闭机器。
words.en: A controller is a device or mechanism that manages or regulates the operation of a machine or system.

words.ex: He speaks in a conversational tone with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友说话时用会话式的语调。
words.en: Relating to or in the style of a conversation; informal and friendly.

words.tr:
n. 律师；劝告
v. 提供咨询；劝告
words.ex: He hired a counsel to defend him in court.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名律师为他在法庭上辩护。
words.en: Counsel refers to the act of giving advice or guidance, especially in a legal context, or to the person who provides such advice.

words.ex: The courier delivered the letter quickly.
words.ex_cn: 信使迅速送来了这封信。
words.en: A courier is a person or company that delivers messages, packages, and mail.

words.ex: My coworker helped me with the report.
words.ex_cn: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。
words.en: A person who works with you in the same organization or team, sharing similar job responsibilities.

words.tr: n. 工艺；手艺；行业；航空器；
words.ex: The craft of pottery takes years to learn.
words.ex_cn: 陶艺工艺需要多年才能掌握。
words.en: Skill in making things by hand; the skilled practice of a practical occupation; the skilled production of decorative or functional objects.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: Children show great creativity when drawing pictures.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在画画时表现出很强的创造力。
words.en: Creativity is the ability to use your imagination to produce new ideas, make things, or think of new solutions to problems.

words.ex: The moon looks like a crescent tonight.
words.ex_cn: 今晚的月亮像一弯新月。
words.en: A crescent is a curved shape that is wider in the middle and pointed at the ends, like the shape of the moon in its first or last quarter.

words.tr: adj. 越野的，横过田野的；横越全国的; n. 越野赛跑
words.ex: He runs cross-country every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都进行越野跑。
words.en: Cross-country refers to traveling or moving across the countryside, rather than using main roads or going through towns and cities. It can also refer to sports or activities that take place across the countryside, such as cross-country skiing or running.

words.tr: adj. 拥挤的；密集的； v. “crowd”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The bus was crowded during rush hour.
words.ex_cn: 高峰时段公交车很拥挤。
words.en: If a place is crowded, it is full of people.

words.ex: They learned about cultural traditions during the trip.
words.ex_cn: 他们在旅行中了解了文化传统。
words.en: Relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society.

words.ex: The child's curiosity made him ask many questions.
words.ex_cn: 孩子的好奇心让他问了很多问题。
words.en: A desire to know or learn about something; something that is interesting because it is unusual or strange.

words.tr:
n. 弯曲；曲线；
v. （使）弯成弧形；
words.ex: The road has a sharp curve ahead.
words.ex_cn: 前面的路有一个急转弯。
words.en: A curve is a smooth, gradually bending line, for example part of the edge of a circle.

words.tr: adj. 大胆的；勇敢的； v. “dare”的现在分词；
words.ex: He made a daring jump off the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 他大胆地从桥上跳了下去。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behaviour as daring, you mean that they are willing to do things which might be dangerous or which might shock or anger other people.

words.ex: The sky will darken before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，天空会变暗。
words.en: To make or become dark or darker.

words.ex: The birds sing at daylight.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在日光下歌唱。
words.en: Daylight is the natural light that comes from the sun during the day.

words.ex: We work during the daytime and rest at night.
words.ex_cn: 我们在白天工作，晚上休息。
words.en: The period of the day when there is natural light, from sunrise to sunset.

words.tr: v. 应付；“deal”的现在分词； n. 交易；
words.ex: He is dealing with a difficult boss.
words.ex_cn: 他正在应付一个难搞的老板。
words.en: Dealing refers to the way in which someone behaves towards other people or the way in which someone does business.

words.tr: adv. 断然地；果断地；明确地；
words.ex: He decidedly refused to join the project.
words.ex_cn: 他断然拒绝参加这个项目。
words.en: In a way that is clear and definite; undoubtedly.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；令人高兴的
words.ex: The garden is delightful in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天时，这个花园令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is delightful is very pleasant, attractive, or enjoyable.

words.tr: adj. 要求高的；费力的； v. 需要；“demand”的现在分词；
words.ex: The job is demanding because it needs long hours and high focus.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作要求高，因为它需要长时间工作和高度专注。
words.en: Requiring much effort or attention; exacting.

words.ex: The designer created a new dress for the show.
words.ex_cn: 这位设计师为这场秀设计了一条新裙子。
words.en: A designer is a person who plans the form, structure, or appearance of something before it is made, by preparing drawings or plans.

words.ex: His determination helped him finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他的决心帮助他完成了比赛。
words.en: Determination is the quality that you show when you have decided to do something and you will not let anything stop you.

words.tr: v. 决心；决定；“determine”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坚决的；坚定的；有决心的；
words.ex: He is determined to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他决心完成比赛。
words.en: If you are determined to do something, you have made a firm decision to do it and will not let anything stop you.

words.ex: He walked directly to the school.
words.ex_cn: 他直接走向学校。
words.en: If you do something directly, you do it without any delay or without involving anyone else.

words.tr: adj. 处于不利地位的；贫困的； v. “disadvantage”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The school helps disadvantaged children with free meals.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为处境不利的孩子提供免费餐食。
words.en: People who are disadvantaged do not have the same opportunities or advantages as other people, often because of their financial situation or social position.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: The storm caused disastrous damage to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴给村庄造成了灾难性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as disastrous, you mean that it is very unfortunate or unsuccessful.

words.tr: n. 迪士尼乐园（美国加利福尼亚州阿纳海姆市的一个主题公园，由华特·迪士尼创建）；
words.ex: We went to Disneyland last summer.
words.ex_cn: 我们去年夏天去了迪士尼乐园。
words.en: Disneyland is a theme park in Anaheim, California, created by Walt Disney and opened in 1955. It is known for its attractions, entertainment, and characters from Disney films.

words.tr: v. 取代；迫使…离开家园；
words.ex: The new robot will displace the workers on the assembly line.
words.ex_cn: 这个新机器人将取代装配线上的工人。
words.en: To displace something or someone means to take their place or to force them to leave their usual place or role.

words.tr: adj. 不开心的，生气的，被得罪了的 v. 冒犯，使生气，使不愉快( displease的过去式和
words.ex: She was clearly displeased with the outcome.
words.ex_cn: 她显然对结果感到不高兴。
words.en: If you are displeased with something, you are not satisfied with it or not happy about it.

words.ex: The diver swam deep under the sea.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员在海底深处游泳。
words.en: A diver is someone who swims under water, especially someone who works under water looking for things or repairing ships.

words.ex: The school values diversity in its students.
words.ex_cn: 学校重视学生的多样性。
words.en: The state of being diverse; variety.

words.tr: n. 潜水；跳水； v. 潜水；跳水；“dive”的现在分词；
words.ex: He loves diving in the clear sea.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在清澈的海里潜水。
words.en: The sport or activity of swimming or exploring underwater.

words.ex: The church has a big dome above the altar.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的祭坛上方有一个大穹顶。
words.en: A dome is a rounded vault made of either curved segments or a shell of revolution, meaning an arch rotated around its central vertical axis.

words.ex: The dominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间占优势的颜色是蓝色。
words.en: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

words.ex: The hospital received a donation of books.
words.ex_cn: 医院收到了一批书籍捐赠。
words.en: A donation is a gift which is given to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: The donor gave money to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 捐赠者向医院捐了钱。
words.en: A donor is a person or organization that gives something, especially money, to a charity or other organization.

words.ex: The cat sat in the doorway.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在门口。
words.en: A doorway is the space in a wall where a door opens and closes, or the covered area just outside a door.

words.ex: The downside of this job is the long hours.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的负面是工作时间很长。
words.en: The downside of something is the aspect of it which is less positive, pleasant, or useful than its other aspects.

words.tr:
n. 水滴
v. 滴落
words.ex: The tap is dripping slowly.
words.ex_cn: 水龙头在慢慢滴水。
words.en: If a liquid drips, it falls in small drops. A drip is also a small amount of liquid that falls in this way.

words.ex: He bought medicine at the drugstore.
words.ex_cn: 他在药店买了药。
words.en: A drugstore is a shop where medicines and other small items are sold.

words.tr:
n. 住宅；住所
v. 居住；栖身；沉湎于；“dwell”的现在分词
words.ex: He lives in a small dwelling near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他住在湖边的一个小住所里。
words.en: A dwelling is a place where someone lives, such as a house or apartment.

words.tr: v. 死；死亡；“die”的现在分词； adj. 临终的；临死的；垂死的；
words.ex: The old man is dying in his sleep.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人在睡梦中去世了。
words.en: If someone is dying, they are very ill and likely to die soon.

words.ex: The pot is made of earthen material.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是土制的。
words.en: Made of earth or clay; relating to or resembling earth.

words.tr: n. 生态学家；生态学者；
words.ex: The ecologist studied birds in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位生态学家研究了森林里的鸟类。
words.en: An ecologist is a scientist who studies the relationships between living things and their environment.

words.ex: The country's economy is growing fast.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家的经济正在快速增长。
words.en: The economy of a country or region is the system by which money, industry, and trade are organized.

words.ex: The forest is a healthy ecosystem.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林是一个健康的生态系统。
words.en: An ecosystem is a complex network or interconnected system, especially one that involves a community of living organisms in conjunction with their environment.

words.tr: adj. 教育的；有教育意义的；
words.ex: This is an educational video for children.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个为儿童制作的教育视频。
words.en: Educational means relating to education or the process of education.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: He is learning elementary math at school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校学习初级数学。
words.en: Elementary means relating to the simplest and most basic aspects of a subject.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: The factory reduces emission to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 工厂减少排放以保护环境。
words.en: An emission is the production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.

words.ex: The empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or territories that are under the control of a single ruler or government.

words.ex: The employee arrived at work early.
words.ex_cn: 这位雇员早早到达了工作地点。
words.en: An employee is a person who is paid to work for an organization or for another person.

words.ex: He found employment after graduating from university.
words.ex_cn: 他大学毕业后找到了工作。
words.en: the condition of having paid work

words.ex: The manager will empower the team to make decisions.
words.ex_cn: 经理将授权团队做决定。
words.en: To give someone the authority or power to do something.

words.tr: adj. 濒临灭绝的；有灭绝危险的； v. “endanger”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The panda is an endangered animal.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫是一种濒临灭绝的动物。
words.en: An animal or plant that is endangered is in danger of becoming extinct.

words.ex: He built his endurance by running every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天早晨跑步来增强耐力。
words.en: The ability to endure an unpleasant or difficult process or situation without giving up.

words.tr: v. 赋予能量；使精力充沛；激励
words.ex: Coffee helps me energize in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 咖啡帮助我在早上恢复活力。
words.en: To energize someone means to give them the enthusiasm, determination, and energy to do something.

words.ex: He wants to study engineering at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习工程。
words.en: Engineering is the work involved in designing and constructing engines and machinery, or structures such as roads and bridges. Engineering is also the subject studied by people who want to do this work.

words.ex: The new job enriched his life.
words.ex_cn: 这份新工作使他的生活富裕起来。
words.en: To enrich something means to improve its quality, often by adding something to it.

words.ex: The clown entertains the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: To entertain someone means to amuse or interest them, for example by telling them stories or jokes, or by playing music for them.

words.tr: n. 表演者；艺人；款待的人
words.ex: The entertainer sang and danced for the children.
words.ex_cn: 这位表演者为孩子们唱歌跳舞。
words.en: An entertainer is a person whose job is to amuse or interest people, for example by telling jokes, singing, or dancing.

words.tr: n. 热心者；热衷于…的人
words.ex: He is an enthusiast of basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他是篮球的爱好者。
words.en: An enthusiast is a person who is very interested in a particular activity or subject and who spends a lot of time on it.

words.tr: adj. 环境的；有关环境的；
words.ex: The government is protecting the environmental balance.
words.ex_cn: 政府正在保护环境平衡。
words.en: Relating to the natural world and the impact of human activity on its condition.

words.ex: The environmentalist plants trees every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这位环保主义者每周末都植树。
words.en: An environmentalist is a person who is concerned with protecting the environment.

words.ex: They equally share the housework.
words.ex_cn: 他们同样分担家务。
words.en: In a manner that is the same in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: The establishment of the school took five years.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的建立花了五年时间。
words.en: The act of establishing something or the state of being established. It can also refer to an organization or institution, especially a business or public body.

words.ex: The teacher gave an evaluation of the student's work.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生的作业进行了评估。
words.en: An evaluation is a judgment about how good, useful, or successful something is.

words.ex: The sun makes the puddle evaporate quickly.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使水坑很快蒸发。
words.en: If a liquid evaporates, or if something evaporates it, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

words.ex: The bird evolved from a small dinosaur.
words.ex_cn: 这种鸟由一种小型恐龙演变而来。
words.en: If something evolves or you evolve it, it gradually develops over a period of time into something different and usually more advanced.

words.ex: Everyone passed the test, with one exception.
words.ex_cn: 所有人都通过了考试，只有一个例外。
words.en: An exception is a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: The museum will exhibit ancient coins next month.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆下个月将展览古钱币。
words.en: To exhibit something means to show it in a public place so that people can go to see it. It can also mean to show a particular quality, ability, or type of behavior.

words.tr: adj. 现存的； v. 存在；“exist”的现在分词；
words.ex: The existing rules need to be changed.
words.ex_cn: 现有的规则需要更改。
words.en: Existing is used to describe something that is present or available now.

words.tr: adj. 外来的；外国来的；奇异的；
words.ex: The market sells exotic fruits from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个市场出售来自其他国家的外来水果。
words.en: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

words.ex: The exploration of space takes many years.
words.ex_cn: 太空探索需要很多年。
words.en: The act of searching for the purpose of discovery of information or resources.

words.ex: The faint light from the candle barely lit the room.
words.ex_cn: 蜡烛微弱的光几乎照不亮房间。
words.en: If you feel faint, you feel weak and as if you are about to lose consciousness. Something that is faint is not strong or clear.

words.ex: The movie was fairly interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影相当地有趣。
words.en: To a moderately sufficient extent or degree.

words.ex: His familiarity with the city helped him find the way.
words.ex_cn: 他对这座城市的熟悉帮助他找到了路。
words.en: A thorough knowledge or mastery of a subject, place, or situation, often gained through experience.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.ex: The filmmaker made a movie about dogs.
words.ex_cn: 这位电影制作人拍了一部关于狗的电影。
words.en: A filmmaker is a person who directs or produces movies for the cinema or television.

words.tr: v. 确定；定案；最终确定
words.ex: He will finalise the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天将最终确定这个计划。
words.en: To complete the last part of a plan, trip, project, etc.

words.tr:
n. 指纹；指印
v. 采指纹
words.ex: The police found his fingerprint on the glass.
words.ex_cn: 警察在玻璃上找到了他的指纹。
words.en: A fingerprint is a mark made by the pattern of ridges on the pad of a human finger, used for identification purposes.

words.ex: The fireman saved the cat from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 消防员从树上救下了那只猫。
words.en: A fireman is a person whose job is to put out fires and rescue people from dangerous situations, especially in buildings.

words.ex: He collected firewood for the campfire.
words.ex_cn: 他为篝火收集了木柴。
words.en: Wood that is cut and used for fuel in fires.

words.ex: He firmly believes in truth.
words.ex_cn: 他坚定地相信真理。
words.en: In a way that is strong and not likely to change or move.

words.ex: Regular exercise improves your fitness.
words.ex_cn: 规律锻炼能改善你的健康。
words.en: The condition of being physically fit and healthy.

words.tr: adj. 固定的；不能变的； v. 修理；固定；确定；“fix”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He has a fixed schedule every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都有一个固定的日程。
words.en: If something is fixed, it is attached or positioned so that it cannot move, or is arranged in a particular way and cannot be changed.

words.ex: He used a roller to flatten the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他用滚筒把泥土压平。
words.en: To flatten something means to make it flat or flatter, or to knock it down to the ground.

words.tr:
n. （鸟或羊）群；（人）群；
v. 聚集；群集；
words.ex: A flock of birds flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 一群鸟飞过田野。
words.en: A flock is a group of birds, sheep, or goats, or a large group of people. It can also refer to a soft material for stuffing cushions, quilts, etc., made from wool or cotton. As a verb, it means to gather or move in a flock.

words.tr: v. 集中；聚焦；“focus”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 注意力集中的；聚焦的；
words.ex: He focused on his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you are focused on something, you are paying special attention to it because it is your main concern or interest.

words.tr: adj. 接着的；下列的； prep. 在...之后； v. 跟随；“follow”的现在分词； n. 下列各项；
words.ex: The following day, we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 接着的那天，我们去了公园。
words.en: Coming after or as a result of something; a group of supporters or admirers.

words.ex: Children walk on the footpath to school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在人行道上步行去学校。
words.en: A footpath is a path that is designed for people to walk along, especially one in the countryside or a park.

words.tr: adj. 禁止的；不许的； v. “forbid”的过去分词；
words.ex: The forbidden area is off-limits to visitors.
words.ex_cn: 这个禁止区域对游客关闭。
words.en: If something is forbidden, you are not allowed to do it or have it.

words.tr: v. 禁止；不准；“forbid”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sign forbids parking here.
words.ex_cn: 这个标志禁止在这里停车。
words.en: If you describe something as forbidding, you mean it has a severe, unfriendly, or threatening appearance.

words.tr: n. 宽恕；原谅；宽宏大量
words.ex: He showed forgiveness after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 争吵之后，他表现出了宽恕。
words.en: The action or process of forgiving or being forgiven.

words.ex: The formation of clouds happens when water vapor cools.
words.ex_cn: 云的形成发生在水蒸气冷却时。
words.en: The process of forming or making something, or the way something is formed or made.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: Steve Jobs is the founder of Apple.
words.ex_cn: 史蒂夫·乔布斯是苹果公司的创办者。
words.en: A founder is someone who establishes an organization, company, or institution. As a verb, it means to fail or collapse, especially in terms of a plan or a ship sinking.

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: Her friendliness made everyone feel welcome.
words.ex_cn: 她的友好让每个人都感到受欢迎。
words.en: The quality of being friendly; affability.

words.tr: adj. 引起恐惧的；使惊恐的；骇人的； v. “frighten”的现在分词；
words.ex: The dark forest looked frightening at night.
words.ex_cn: 那个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来很吓人。
words.en: If you say that something is frightening, you mean that it makes you feel afraid or anxious.

words.ex: The fringe of the forest is full of wildflowers.
words.ex_cn: 森林的边缘长满了野花。
words.en: The outer, marginal, or extreme part of an area, group, or sphere of activity.

words.tr: adj. 冰冻的；冻结的； v. “freeze”的过去分词；
words.ex: The frozen fish tastes fresh.
words.ex_cn: 冰冻的鱼尝起来很新鲜。
words.en: If something is frozen, it has been turned into ice or has become very hard because of cold temperature.

words.ex: The meeting was fruitful and solved many problems.
words.ex_cn: 这次会议富有成效，解决了许多问题。
words.en: Producing good or helpful results; productive.

words.ex: He couldn't hide his frustration after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后无法掩饰自己的沮丧。
words.en: The feeling of being upset or annoyed as a result of being unable to change or achieve something.

words.tr: n. 园艺（学）； v. 从事园艺；“garden”的现在分词；
words.ex: He enjoys gardening in his backyard.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在后院做园艺。
words.en: The activity of tending and cultivating a garden, especially as a pastime.

words.tr:
n. 凝视；注视；
v. 凝视；注视；
words.ex: His gaze fixed on the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他的凝视固定在日落上。
words.en: If you gaze at someone or something, you look steadily at them for a long time, for example because you find them attractive or interesting, or because you are thinking about something else.

words.ex: He shifted the gear to slow down the car.
words.ex_cn: 他换挡以减慢车速。
words.en: Gear refers to a toothed wheel that works with others to alter the relation between the speed of a driving mechanism (such as the engine of a vehicle) and the speed of the driven parts (the wheels). It can also mean equipment that is used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.ex: She generally wakes up at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 她通常在早上七点起床。
words.en: In most cases; usually.

words.ex: He is learning genetics in biology class.
words.ex_cn: 他在生物课上学习遗传学。
words.en: Genetics is the study of how characteristics are passed from one generation to another through genes.

words.tr: adv. 温柔地；温和地；轻轻地；
words.ex: She gently woke the baby.
words.ex_cn: 她温柔地叫醒了宝宝。
words.en: In a mild, kind, or tender manner; not harshly or severely.

words.ex: The map shows geographic features like mountains and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图显示了山脉和河流等地理特征。
words.en: Relating to the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.ex: The glacier moves slowly down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 冰川缓慢地沿着山向下移动。
words.en: A glacier is a large, persistent body of ice that forms where the accumulation of snow exceeds its ablation over many years, often centuries.

words.ex: Globalisation is changing how countries trade with each other.
words.ex_cn: 全球化正在改变国家之间的贸易方式。
words.en: Globalisation is the process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

words.ex: The glow of the fire warmed the room.
words.ex_cn: 火的炽热温暖了房间。
words.en: If something glows, it produces a dull, steady light.

words.ex: She dresses like a goddess on Halloween.
words.ex_cn: 她在万圣节打扮得像一位女神。
words.en: A goddess is a female deity. In many cultures, goddesses are associated with Earth, motherhood, love, and the household.

words.tr: v. 去；走；“go”的过去分词； adj. 已往的；离去的；死去的；
words.ex: He is gone to the store.
words.ex_cn: 他去商店了。
words.en: No longer present; departed.

words.ex: The governor signed the new law yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 州长昨天签署了这项新法律。
words.en: A governor is a person who is responsible for the political administration of a region, such as a state or a colony.

words.tr:
v. 分级；“grade的过去式和过去分词”
adj. 分等级的
words.ex: The books were graded by difficulty.
words.ex_cn: 这些书按难度分了级。
words.en: Arranged in or divided into levels of quality or ability.

words.ex: The grower sells fresh vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 这位种植者在市场出售新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: A grower is someone who grows plants or crops as a business or for personal use.

words.ex: He felt guilt after lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在对朋友撒谎后感到内疚。
words.en: Guilt is an unhappy feeling that you have because you have done something wrong or think that you have done something wrong.

words.tr: v. 发生；“happen”的现在分词； n. 事件；偶然发生的事；
words.ex: What is happening now?
words.ex_cn: 现在发生了什么？
words.en: an event or occurrence

words.ex: He made a table from hardwood.
words.ex_cn: 他用硬木做了一张桌子。
words.en: Hardwood is wood from broad-leaved trees such as oak, ash, or beech, as opposed to conifers.

words.tr: n. 港口；避难所；安全的地方；
words.ex: The small fishing boat docked at the haven.
words.ex_cn: 那艘小渔船停靠在港口。
words.en: A haven is a place of safety or refuge.

words.tr: n. 治疗；疗癒；愈合； v. “heal”的现在分词；
words.ex: The healing of the wound took two weeks.
words.ex_cn: 伤口的治疗花了两周时间。
words.en: The process of becoming healthy again, especially after a cut or other injury, or of making someone healthy again.

words.tr:
adj. 令人心碎的；令人悲痛的
v. 使心碎；“heartbreak”的现在分词
words.ex: The movie showed a heartbreaking goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了一个令人心碎的告别。
words.en: Causing overwhelming distress or sadness.

words.tr: adj. 加热了的；激烈的； v. 加热；“heat”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The heated water bubbled in the pot.
words.ex_cn: 加热过的水在锅里冒泡。
words.en: If a discussion or debate is heated, it involves a lot of strong and often angry feelings.

words.ex: It rained heavily last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚雨下得很大。
words.en: To a great degree; in large amounts.

words.ex: The farmer owns five hectares of land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民拥有五公顷土地。
words.en: A hectare is a unit of measurement of area, equal to 10,000 square metres or approximately 2.471 acres.

words.tr: adj. 隐藏的； v. 隐藏；“hide”的过去分词；
words.ex: The keys are hidden under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: If something is hidden, it is not easily noticed or found.

words.ex: The sheep graze on the highland.
words.ex_cn: 羊在高地上吃草。
words.en: Highland refers to an area of high or mountainous land, often characterized by its elevation above sea level and distinct geographical features.

words.ex: He is highly talented.
words.ex_cn: 他非常有才华。
words.en: to a high degree or level; very

words.tr:
n. 高科技
adj. 高技术的
words.ex: He works in a high-tech company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家高科技公司工作。
words.en: Involving or using advanced technology.

words.tr: n. 暗示；提示；有益的建议；
words.ex: He gave me a hint about the surprise party.
words.ex_cn: 他给了我关于惊喜派对的暗示。
words.en: A hint is a slight or indirect indication or suggestion.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.ex: He read a historical book about ancient Rome.
words.ex_cn: 他读了一本关于古罗马的历史书。
words.en: Historical means relating to the study of history or connected with the past.

words.ex: The homeless man slept on the bench.
words.ex_cn: 那个无家可归的人睡在长椅上。
words.en: If someone is homeless, they have no permanent place to live.

words.ex: She is a homemaker who takes care of her children.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位照顾孩子的家庭主妇。
words.en: A homemaker is a person, especially a housewife, who manages a home.

words.ex: The homeowner fixed the roof himself.
words.ex_cn: 房主自己修了屋顶。
words.en: A homeowner is a person who owns the house or apartment they live in.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: Hopefully, it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 但愿明天会下雨。
words.en: If you say that something will happen hopefully, you mean that you wish it to happen or you think it is likely to happen.

words.ex: The horror of the dark made her scream.
words.ex_cn: 对黑暗的恐惧让她尖叫。
words.en: A feeling of great fear, shock, or disgust.

words.ex: The humidity in the room made the air feel heavy.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的湿度让空气感觉很闷。
words.en: Humidity is the amount of water vapor in the air. High humidity makes the air feel wet and sticky.

words.ex: Her icy smile made him feel cold.
words.ex_cn: 她冰冷的微笑让他感到寒意。
words.en: If you describe something as icy, you mean that it is extremely cold.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The mirror creates an illusion of a bigger room.
words.ex_cn: 镜子制造出房间更大的错觉。
words.en: An illusion is a false idea or belief, especially about yourself or your situation.

words.ex: The dragon is an imaginary creature.
words.ex_cn: 龙是一种想象中的生物。
words.en: An imaginary person, place, or thing is one that does not exist or is not real, but that people think about or talk about.

words.ex: Children have a strong imagination.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们有很强的想象力。
words.en: The ability to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or not real.

words.ex: The child gave an imaginative story about flying cats.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子讲了一个关于会飞的猫的富有想象力的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or their ideas as imaginative, you are praising them because they are easily able to think of or create new or exciting things.

words.tr: adj. 即刻的；立即的；紧接的；最近的；
words.ex: He needs immediate help.
words.ex_cn: 他需要即刻的帮助。
words.en: An immediate action, event, or situation happens or exists without any delay.

words.ex: The immigrant found a job in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这位移民在城市里找到了一份工作。
words.en: An immigrant is a person who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

words.ex: The painting showed a few small imperfections that the artist had missed.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画显示出艺术家忽略的几个小瑕疵。
words.en: An imperfection in something is a fault, weakness, or undesirable feature that it has.

words.ex: The dentist placed a dental implant to replace the missing tooth.
words.ex_cn: 牙医植入了一个牙科植入物来替代缺失的牙齿。
words.en: To implant something means to put it firmly into something else, especially into a person's body.
