words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.tr: adj. 不活动的；不活跃的；怠惰的；
words.ex: The old man is inactive because of his illness.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人因为生病而不活动。
words.en: If someone or something is inactive, they are not doing anything or are not working.

words.tr: prep. 包括；包含； v. 包括；包含；“include”的现在分词；
words.ex: The package includes apples, bananas, and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹包括苹果、香蕉和橙子。
words.en: You use including to introduce examples of people or things that are part of the group of people or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: He did an in-depth study of the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题进行了深入的研究。
words.en: If you do something in depth, you do it very thoroughly and consider all the details.

words.ex: The city has many industrial factories.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市有许多工业工厂。
words.en: Industrial means relating to or characterized by industry.

words.ex: This store sells inexpensive clothes.
words.ex_cn: 这家店卖不贵的衣服。
words.en: Something that is inexpensive does not cost a lot of money.

words.ex: The virus can infect people quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒能迅速感染人。
words.en: To infect someone or something means to cause them to have a disease or illness.

words.ex: The stars seem to go on to infinity.
words.ex_cn: 星星似乎延伸到无限。
words.en: Infinity is a concept of something that is unlimited, endless, without bound.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.tr: adj. 受伤的；受损害的； v. “injure”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The injured player was taken to the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 受伤的球员被送往医院。
words.en: If you are injured, you have been hurt, usually in an accident or attack.

words.ex: I will see you in person tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天亲自见你。
words.en: If you do something in person, you do it yourself rather than letting someone else do it for you.

words.ex: The painting gave me inspiration.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画给了我灵感。
words.en: Inspiration is a feeling of enthusiasm you get from someone or something, which gives you new and creative ideas.

words.tr: adj. 鼓舞人心的；给予灵感的；
words.ex: Her speech was inspirational and made everyone feel hopeful.
words.ex_cn: 她的演讲鼓舞人心，让每个人都感到充满希望。
words.en: Something that is inspirational provides encouragement or new ideas for what you should do.

words.ex: The instructor explained the math problem clearly.
words.ex_cn: 教员清楚地讲解了这道数学题。
words.en: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill or subject, especially in a college or university, or in a specialized field such as driving or skiing.

words.ex: The doctor checked his daily intake of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他每天的糖摄入量。
words.en: The process of taking something in, especially food, air, or information.

words.ex: He tried to intellectualize every aspect of his life.
words.ex_cn: 他试图使生活的各个方面都知识化。
words.en: To intellectualize means to analyze or approach something from an intellectual perspective, often by applying logic and reasoning rather than emotion.

words.ex: He shows high intelligence in solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他在解决数学问题时表现出很高的智力。
words.en: The ability to acquire and apply knowledge and skills.

words.tr: adj. 打算中的；有意的； v. 打算；“intend”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The intended plan was to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 打算中的计划是去徒步旅行。
words.en: If something is intended for a particular purpose, it has been planned to fulfill that purpose.

words.ex: He gave an intentional wrong answer to confuse the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他故意答错答案来迷惑老师。
words.en: Something that is intentional is done on purpose, not by chance.

words.tr: v. 互相作用；互相影响；交流；沟通；
words.ex: The two chemicals interact when mixed.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质混合时会互相作用。
words.en: If people interact with each other, they communicate or work together.

words.ex: The app has an interactive game for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个应用有一个适合孩子的交互式游戏。
words.en: An interactive computer program or system is designed to involve the user in the exchange of information.

words.tr: adj. 人与人之间的；人际关系的；
words.ex: Good interpersonal skills help people work together.
words.ex_cn: 良好的人际交往能力有助于人们合作。
words.en: relating to relationships or communication between people

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: The phone call caused an interruption in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 电话打断了会议。
words.en: An interruption is something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation.

words.tr: adj. 无价的；非常宝贵的；
words.ex: Her advice was invaluable to me.
words.ex_cn: 她的建议对我而言是无价的。
words.en: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.tr: adj. 偏远的；隔离的；孤独的； v. 使隔离；“isolate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The village is isolated, far from any city.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄很偏远，远离任何城市。
words.en: If something is isolated, it is far away from other places, buildings, or people.

words.ex: He felt isolation after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到孤立。
words.en: The state of being in a place or situation that is separate from others

words.tr:
adj. 意大利的；意大利人的；意大利语的；
n. 意大利语；意大利人；
words.ex: She loves italian food.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢意大利食物。
words.en: Of or relating to Italy, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.tr: adj. 高兴的；快乐的；令人愉快的
words.ex: The children are joyful at the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在派对上很快乐。
words.en: Feeling, expressing, or causing great pleasure and happiness.

words.ex: He uses a juicer to make orange juice.
words.ex_cn: 他用榨汁机做橙汁。
words.en: A juicer is a device used to extract juice from fruits, vegetables, or leafy greens.

words.tr: adj. 多汁的；利润丰厚的；有趣味的
words.ex: The apple is juicy and sweet.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果多汁又甜。
words.en: If you describe something as juicy, you mean that it is very interesting or exciting, especially because it involves scandalous or personal information.

words.tr: v. 杀死；“kill”的现在分词； n. 杀人； adj. 致命的；
words.ex: The lion was killing a deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只狮子正在杀死一只鹿。
words.en: The act of causing death, especially deliberately; or something that causes death or is very difficult to endure.

words.tr: n. 实际知识；技术；窍门
words.ex: He has the know-how to fix the machine.
words.ex_cn: 他有修理这台机器的诀窍。
words.en: Practical knowledge or expertise in a particular field or area.

words.ex: He is knowledgeable about history and science.
words.ex_cn: 他对历史和科学都很博学。
words.en: Someone who is knowledgeable has or shows a clear understanding of many different facts about the world or about a particular subject.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.tr: n. 着陆；降落；楼梯平台； v. “land”的现在分词；
words.ex: The plane made a smooth landing at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在机场平稳着陆。
words.en: The act of coming to or bringing something to land, especially an aircraft.

words.tr:
adj. 最新的；最后的；最近的；
n. 最新事物；
words.ex: He bought the latest phone on the market.
words.ex_cn: 他买了市场上最新的手机。
words.en: The most recent or the newest.

words.tr: adj. 最重要的；一流的；处于领导地位的； v. “lead”的现在分词；带领；领导；
words.ex: He is the leading scientist in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的科学家。
words.en: If something is leading in a particular area, it is the most important or advanced thing in that area.

words.ex: The tree has leafy branches in summer.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在夏天有茂密的枝叶。
words.en: A leafy place has a lot of leaves on the trees or plants.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.ex: She will lengthen the dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她会把裙子改长一点去参加派对。
words.en: To make something longer, or to become longer.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.tr:
v. 舔；（火焰）掠过；克服
n. 舔；少许
words.ex: The dog licks its paw.
words.ex_cn: 狗舔它的爪子。
words.en: To pass the tongue over something; to defeat someone easily.

words.ex: The doll has a lifelike face.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩具有一个逼真的脸。
words.en: If something is lifelike, it is very similar to the thing it represents or imitates, especially in a way that is surprising or impressive.

words.ex: He lives a 24/7 lifestyle, working and texting all day and night.
words.ex_cn: 他过着24/7的生活方式，整天整夜地工作和发信息。
words.en: The way in which a person lives is their lifestyle.

words.ex: He answered the question lightly.
words.ex_cn: 他轻率地回答了那个问题。
words.en: In a way that is not heavy or forceful; gently.

words.tr: adj. 可爱的；讨人喜欢的
words.ex: He is a likable person who always smiles.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个讨人喜欢的人，总是面带微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as likable, you mean that they are pleasant and easy to like.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.tr: v. 位于；使坐落于；查找…的地点；确定…的位置；“locate”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 坐落在；位于；
words.ex: The school is located near the park.
words.ex_cn: 学校位于公园附近。
words.en: If something is located in a particular place, it is in that place.

words.tr: n. （有锁的）寄物柜；锁柜；上锁的人
words.ex: He put his books in the locker.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放在储物柜里。
words.en: A locker is a small storage compartment, typically in a public place such as a school, gym, or workplace, where individuals can store their personal belongings securely.

words.ex: He uses logic to solve the puzzle.
words.ex_cn: 他用逻辑来解决这个谜题。
words.en: Logic is a method of reasoning that involves a series of statements, each of which must be true if the statement before it is true.

words.tr:
n. 织布机；
v. 迫近；
words.ex: The old loom made a loud clicking sound.
words.ex_cn: 那台旧织布机发出很大的咔嗒声。
words.en: If something looms over you, it appears as a large or unclear shape, often in a way that is frightening or causes worry.

words.tr: adj. 丢失的； v. 丢失；输；“lose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The lost keys were found under the table.
words.ex_cn: 丢失的钥匙在桌子下面找到了。
words.en: If you are lost, you do not know where you are or you are unable to find your way.

words.tr:
n. 低地；
adj. 低地的；
words.ex: The farmers live in the lowland near the river.
words.ex_cn: 农民们住在河边的低地上。
words.en: Lowland refers to an area of land that is low in relation to the surrounding country.

words.tr: n. 疯狂；疯癫；愚蠢的行为；
words.ex: His madness led him to jump off the building.
words.ex_cn: 他的疯狂让他从大楼上跳了下去。
words.en: Madness is a state of being mentally ill, especially severely. It can also refer to a state of wild or chaotic activity.

words.tr: adj. 奇妙的；魔术的；有魔力的；
words.ex: The magical night lit up the whole village.
words.ex_cn: 奇妙的夜晚照亮了整个村庄。
words.en: Something that is magical seems to use magic or to be full of magic.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.tr: v. 使得；制作；做；“make”的现在分词； n. 制造；
words.ex: The rain is making the road slippery.
words.ex_cn: 下雨使得道路变得滑。
words.en: The process of creating or producing something.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.ex: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 枫树的叶子在秋天变红。
words.en: A maple is a tree or shrub with lobed leaves, winged fruits, and colorful autumn foliage, which is often cultivated for its sap, wood, or ornamental value.

words.ex: He eats bread with marmalade for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃涂了果酱的面包。
words.en: Marmalade is a sweet food made from fruit, sugar, and water, especially oranges, which is spread on bread or used in cooking.

words.ex: The painting is considered a masterpiece by art critics.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画被艺术评论家视为杰作。
words.en: A masterpiece is a work of art such as a painting, film, or book that is made with great skill and is considered to be the best work of a particular artist or writer.

words.ex: He painted a masterwork that everyone admires.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅人人都赞赏的杰作。
words.en: A masterwork is a work of art, literature, or music that is of very high quality and is regarded as the best work of its creator.

words.ex: He achieved mastery of the piano after ten years of practice.
words.ex_cn: 他经过十年的练习，熟练掌握了钢琴。
words.en: If you show mastery of a particular skill or language, you show that you have learned or understood it completely and have no difficulty using it.

words.tr: n. 匹配； adj. 匹配的； v. 相配；“match”的现在分词；
words.ex: The matching of colors makes the room look nice.
words.ex_cn: 颜色的匹配让房间看起来很漂亮。
words.en: If one thing is matching with another, they are similar in appearance, style, or color and therefore look attractive together.

words.tr: n. 迷宫；错综复杂的曲径；
words.ex: The children got lost in the maze.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在迷宫里迷路了。
words.en: A maze is a complex system of paths or passages in which it is easy to get lost.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

words.ex: The weight of the box is measurable.
words.ex_cn: 这个箱子的重量是可以测量的。
words.en: If something is measurable, it can be measured or quantified.

words.ex: He reads mediaeval stories about knights.
words.ex_cn: 他读关于骑士的中世纪故事。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages.

words.ex: This plant has medicinal properties.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有药用价值。
words.en: Having healing properties; used in the treatment of disease.

words.ex: He wrote a memoir about his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一本关于自己童年的回忆录。
words.en: A memoir is a book or article that you write about someone who you have known, describing what you remember of them and of particular events in which you both took part.

words.ex: He tries to memorize the words every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天试着记住这些单词。
words.en: To memorize something means to learn it so well that you can remember it perfectly.

words.ex: His mentality changed after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他的心理状态发生了变化。
words.en: Your mentality is your attitudes and your way of thinking.

words.tr:
n. 信息发送
v. 给…发消息；给…留言；“message”的现在分词
words.ex: The company is investing heavily in improving its messaging system.
words.ex_cn: 公司正在大力投资改进其信息收发系统。
words.en: The sending and receiving of messages, especially electronically.

words.ex: The poem uses metaphorical language to express love.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗使用隐喻的语言来表达爱。
words.en: Using or containing metaphor; figurative.

words.ex: He lives in a big metropolis with many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个有很多高楼的大都市里。
words.en: A metropolis is a very large city, often the most important city in a country or area.

words.ex: The middle-aged man walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位中年男子每天早上遛狗。
words.en: Middle-aged refers to someone who is in the middle of their life, typically between the ages of about 45 and 65.

words.ex: The milk looks milky and smooth.
words.ex_cn: 这牛奶看起来乳状且顺滑。
words.en: Resembling milk in color or consistency; containing milk.

words.ex: He lost his job, which was a great misfortune.
words.ex_cn: 他丢了工作，这是一场巨大的不幸。
words.en: An unfortunate condition or event.

words.ex: He misleads his friends with false stories.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚假的故事误导他的朋友。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.ex: He misread the sign and took the wrong turn.
words.ex_cn: 他看错了标志，拐错了弯。
words.en: To misunderstand or interpret something incorrectly.

words.ex: The morning was misty and quiet.
words.ex_cn: 早晨雾蒙蒙的，很安静。
words.en: If the weather is misty, there is mist in the air that makes it difficult to see far.

words.tr:
n. 建模；造型；模特儿职业
v. 做模型；模仿；塑造；“model”的现在分词
words.ex: He is modeling a new bridge with computer software.
words.ex_cn: 他正在用计算机软件模拟一座新桥。
words.en: The act or profession of creating models, especially in fashion, art, or science.

words.ex: My mother-in-law lives next door.
words.ex_cn: 我的岳母住在隔壁。
words.en: The mother of one's spouse.

words.ex: The village is built on the mountainside.
words.ex_cn: 村庄建在山腰上。
words.en: The side or slope of a mountain.

words.tr:
adj. 可移动的；活动的
n. 动产；可移动的东西
words.ex: The chair is moveable and easy to push.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以移动，很容易推。
words.en: Capable of being moved; not fixed in one place or position.

words.ex: The bacteria multiply quickly.
words.ex_cn: 细菌迅速增加。
words.en: If you multiply one number by another, you add the first number to itself as many times as is indicated by the second number. For example, 2 multiplied by 3 is equal to 6.

words.ex: The artist painted a colorful mural on the school wall.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家在学校墙上画了一幅色彩斑斓的壁画。
words.en: A mural is a large painting, typically executed directly on a wall.

words.tr: adv. 自然地；理所当然地；
words.ex: Babies cry naturally when they are hungry.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿饿了时会自然地哭。
words.en: in a natural manner; as a matter of course; by nature

words.ex: The ship uses GPS for navigation.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船使用GPS进行导航。
words.en: The process or activity of accurately ascertaining one's position and planning and following a route.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: The neighboring house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 邻近的那所房子有一个大花园。
words.en: Located or living near or next to a place or person.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.ex: The newcomer joined our class last week.
words.ex_cn: 这个新来的人上周加入了我们的班级。
words.en: A newcomer is a person who has recently arrived in a place or started an activity.

words.ex: He was newly hired as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他最近被聘为老师。
words.en: Newly means something that has happened or been done recently.

words.ex: The newness of the phone excited her.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机的新颖让她兴奋。
words.en: The quality of being new; novelty.

words.ex: They will nominate her for the award.
words.ex_cn: 他们将提名她获得这个奖项。
words.en: If someone is nominated for a job or position, their name is formally suggested as a candidate for it.

words.tr: adj. 非原生的；非本地的
words.ex: He is a non-native speaker of English.
words.ex_cn: 他不是英语母语者。
words.en: A non-native person or thing is one that does not originate from or is not indigenous to a particular place.

words.ex: He works at a nonprofit that helps children.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家帮助儿童的非营利组织工作。
words.en: An organization that uses its surplus revenue to achieve its goal rather than distributing it as profit or dividends.

words.ex: He normally goes to bed at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 他通常晚上10点睡觉。
words.en: If you say that something normally happens or that you normally do a particular thing, you mean that it is what usually happens or what you usually do.

words.tr:
adj. 挪威（人，语）的；
n. 挪威语；
words.ex: He speaks Norwegian fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地说挪威语。
words.en: Belonging or relating to Norway, its people, or its language.

words.tr: n. 护理（工作）；护理行业； v. “nurse”的现在分词；
words.ex: She works in nursing at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她在当地医院从事护理工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of providing care for the sick and infirm.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.tr: n. 得罪人的人；犯罪者；违法者；
words.ex: He was punished because he was an offender who hurt his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为是一个得罪朋友的人而受到惩罚。
words.en: An offender is a person who commits a crime or does something wrong.

words.ex: He was officially appointed as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 他被正式任命为新经理。
words.en: In a formal or authoritative manner; according to the rules or laws.

words.tr: adj. 在船上的；在飞机上的；
words.ex: The onboard crew served dinner to the passengers.
words.ex_cn: 船上的工作人员为乘客提供晚餐。
words.en: onboard: to join or integrate into a team, project, or system.

words.ex: This is a one-off payment for the special service.
words.ex_cn: 这是为这项特殊服务支付的一次性费用。
words.en: A one-off thing is made or happens only once.

words.tr: adj. 一次性的；临时的；曾经的
words.ex: He paid one-time fee to join the club.
words.ex_cn: 他支付了一次性费用加入俱乐部。
words.en: Occurring or done on one single occasion; former.

words.tr: adj. 开放式的；无限制的；自由回答的；两端未封闭的
words.ex: The discussion was open-ended, allowing for a wide range of opinions.
words.ex_cn: 讨论是开放式的，允许广泛的意见。
words.en: An open-ended activity or situation does not have a planned ending, so it may develop in several ways.

words.tr: adv. 公开地；毫不隐瞒地；坦率地；
words.ex: He openly admitted his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他公开承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you do something openly, you do it without hiding any facts or hiding your feelings.

words.ex: His openness helped the team trust him.
words.ex_cn: 他的开放态度让团队信任他。
words.en: The quality or state of being open, especially in terms of being honest and not hiding one's thoughts or feelings.

words.tr: v. 运转；操作；“operate”的现在分词； adj. 运行的；
words.ex: The machine is operating smoothly.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器运转得很顺畅。
words.en: Operating refers to the action of functioning or working, especially in a business or medical context.

words.tr: adj. 反对的；敌对的； v. 反对；反抗；“oppose”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was opposed to the new rule.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这个新规定。
words.en: If you are opposed to something, you disagree with it or disapprove of it.

words.ex: He gave an oral report in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上做了口头报告。
words.en: Relating to the mouth; spoken rather than written.

words.ex: He plays violin in a local orchestra.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个本地管弦乐队中拉小提琴。
words.en: An orchestra is a large group of musicians who play a variety of different instruments together. Orchestras usually play classical music.

words.tr: adj. 有组织的； v. 组织；“organize”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: She is an organized student who keeps her books in order.
words.ex_cn: 她是一个有条理的学生，把书整理得井井有条。
words.en: If something is organized, it is arranged in an orderly, efficient way.

words.ex: Originally, he wanted to be a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 起初，他想当一名老师。
words.en: Initially; in the first place; in a novel or inventive manner.

words.ex: This tradition originates from ancient times.
words.ex_cn: 这个传统起源于古代。
words.en: To originate means to have a specific beginning or to start something.

words.ex: He is ostensibly helping, but he is really slowing us down.
words.ex_cn: 他表面上在帮忙，但实际上是在拖后腿。
words.en: Used to indicate that something seems to be true or is officially stated to be true, but might not be.

words.ex: The outbreak of the flu surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 流感的爆发让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: An outbreak of something unpleasant, such as violence or a disease, is a sudden occurrence of it.

words.ex: This phone is outdated and doesn't work well.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机过时了，用起来不好。
words.en: If you describe something as outdated, you mean that you think it is old-fashioned and no longer useful or relevant to modern life.

words.ex: The child outgrew his shoes in one year.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子一年内就长高了，鞋子都穿不下了。
words.en: If you outgrow a particular way of behaving or thinking, you change and become more mature, so that you no longer behave or think in that way.

words.tr: vt. 使过量预订；超额订出
words.ex: The hotel overbooked rooms for the weekend.
words.ex_cn: 这家酒店在周末超出了预订量。
words.en: To accept more reservations or bookings than there is space or capacity available.

words.tr: v. 暴食；吃得过量；吃撑
words.ex: He overate at the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 他在生日聚会上吃太多了。
words.en: To eat more food than your body needs, especially so that you feel uncomfortably full.

words.ex: He overheard them talking about the party.
words.ex_cn: 他无意中听到他们在谈论派对。
words.en: To overhear is to hear what someone is saying without them knowing that you are listening.

words.tr:
adj. 充满喜悦的；大喜的
v. 使大喜；“overjoy”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She was overjoyed when she got the gift.
words.ex_cn: 她收到礼物时欣喜若狂。
words.en: If you are overjoyed, you are extremely happy about something.

words.tr:
adv. 在夜里；突然；
adj. 整晚的；
words.ex: The baby slept overnight in the crib.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿整夜睡在小床上。
words.en: If something happens overnight, it happens during the night or for the period of one night. It can also mean happening very quickly or suddenly.

words.tr: v. 反应过火；反应过度
words.ex: He overreacts when he hears bad news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到坏消息时，他会反应过度。
words.en: If someone overreacts to something, they have and show more of an emotion than is necessary or appropriate.

words.ex: He is overweight because he eats too much junk food.
words.ex_cn: 他超重是因为吃太多垃圾食品。
words.en: If someone is overweight, they weigh more than is considered healthy or attractive.

words.ex: We played paintball last weekend and it was incredibly fun.
words.ex_cn: n. 我们上周末玩了彩弹射击游戏，非常有趣。
words.en: Paintball is a game in which players compete by shooting pellets of paint at each other from air guns, with the objective of marking opponents and avoiding being marked themselves.

words.ex: The palm tree grows near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 棕榈树长在海滩附近。
words.en: The inner surface of the hand that extends from the wrist to the base of the fingers; also refers to the tropical tree with large divided leaves.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上写了名字。
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr:
n. 游行；阅兵；
v. 游行；阅兵；
words.ex: The city held a big parade on Independence Day.
words.ex_cn: 城市在独立日举行了盛大的游行。
words.en: A parade is a procession of people or vehicles moving through a public place in order to celebrate an important day or event.

words.tr: n. 公园绿地；公用场地；
words.ex: The children play in the parkland after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在公园绿地里玩耍。
words.en: Parkland refers to land that is designated or used as a park, typically characterized by its green, open spaces and recreational facilities.

words.ex: Each participant must sign the form.
words.ex_cn: 每个参与者都必须签署表格。
words.en: A participant is someone who takes part in an activity or event.

words.ex: I like fruits, particularly apples.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
words.en: Used to single out a subject to which a statement is especially applicable.

words.ex: Reading books is his favorite pastime.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: A pastime is something that you do because you enjoy it or are interested in it, rather than as a job.

words.tr: adv. 完美地；圆满地；完全地；
words.ex: She sang perfectly in the concert.
words.ex_cn: 她在演唱会上唱得完美极了。
words.en: In a perfect manner; completely or entirely.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.ex: The pigeon sits on the window sill.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子坐在窗台上。
words.en: A pigeon is a bird, usually grey in color, that is often seen in towns and is sometimes used for carrying messages.

words.ex: He put his head on the pillow and fell asleep.
words.ex_cn: 他把头放在枕头上，睡着了。
words.en: A pillow is a cushion that you rest your head on when you are in bed.

words.tr: n. 计划；规划； v. 计划；打算；“plan”的现在分词；
words.ex: The planning for the trip took a week.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅行的计划花了一周时间。
words.en: The process of making plans for something.

words.ex: Children play in the plaza after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在广场上玩耍。
words.en: A plaza is an open public space that is found in the heart of a city or town. It is often surrounded by buildings and may include shops, restaurants, and other amenities.

words.tr:
n. 梅子；李子；紫红色；青紫色；令人垂涎的东西
adj. 令人垂涎的；吸引人的
words.ex: He ate a ripe plum for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个熟透的李子。
words.en: A plum is a sweet, juicy fruit with a smooth, red or purple skin and a stone in the middle.

words.ex: She wrote a poetic letter to her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她给朋友写了一封诗意的信。
words.en: Something that is poetic is very beautiful and expresses emotions in a sensitive or moving way.

words.tr: n. 中毒； v. “poison”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child suffered from poisoning after eating the berries.
words.ex_cn: 孩子吃了这些浆果后中毒了。
words.en: The act or process of administering poison or becoming poisoned.

words.tr: n. 决策者；政策制定者
words.ex: The policymaker made a new rule for schools.
words.ex_cn: 这位政策制定者为学校制定了一项新规定。
words.en: A policymaker is a person responsible for or involved in formulating policies, especially in government.

words.tr: adv. 糟糕地；拙劣地；不足；
words.ex: He performed poorly in the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试中表现得很糟糕。
words.en: In a manner that is not good or satisfactory.

words.ex: The popularity of this song grew quickly on social media.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在社交媒体上的流行迅速增长。
words.en: The state or condition of being liked, admired, or supported by many people.

words.tr: v. 居住于；生活于；移民于
words.ex: Many people populate this small town.
words.ex_cn: 许多人居住在这个小镇上。
words.en: To populate an area means to live in it or to fill it with people or things.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.ex: He ate only a small portion of the cake.
words.ex_cn: 他只吃了一小部分蛋糕。
words.en: A portion of something is a part of it.

words.ex: He painted a portrait of his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一幅他母亲的肖像。
words.en: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

words.ex: He is potentially going to win the race.
words.ex_cn: 他有可能赢得比赛。
words.en: in a way that is possible or likely to happen or be true

words.tr: n. 发电厂；精力旺盛的人；强大的集团（或组织）
words.ex: The old powerhouse still provides electricity for the town.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧发电厂仍为这个城镇供电。
words.en: A powerhouse is an organization or country that is very strong or important, or a person who is very energetic.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.ex: Dark clouds are a predictor of rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云是下雨的预示物。
words.en: A predictor is someone or something that makes it possible for you to say what will happen or how someone will behave in the future.

words.ex: The cave paintings are prehistoric.
words.ex_cn: 这些洞穴壁画是史前的。
words.en: Belonging to or existing in times before recorded history.

words.tr:
adj. 学龄前的；入学前的；
n. 幼儿园；幼稚园；
words.ex: He attends a preschool program every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上参加学龄前课程。
words.en: A school for children who are too young to attend kindergarten, typically for those aged between three and five.

words.ex: His presence made everyone feel calm.
words.ex_cn: 他的存在让每个人都感到平静。
words.en: The state or fact of existing, occurring, or being present in a place or thing.

words.tr: n. 演讲人；节目主持人；发言人；呈献者；
words.ex: The presenter told a funny story to the audience.
words.ex_cn: 演讲人给观众讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A presenter is a person who introduces or hosts a television or radio program, or who introduces a speaker or performer at a public event.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.ex: He primarily works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他主要是一名老师。
words.en: You use primarily to say what is mainly true in a particular situation.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.ex: He values his privacy and doesn't share personal info online.
words.ex_cn: 他重视自己的隐私，不在网上分享个人信息。
words.en: The state or condition of being free from being observed or disturbed by other people.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.tr: n. 提供者；供应者；供养人；
words.ex: The hospital is a health care provider.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家医疗服务提供者。
words.en: A provider is a person or organization that supplies or makes available something that is needed or wanted.

words.ex: The provincial government opened a new school.
words.ex_cn: 省政府开设了一所新学校。
words.en: Relating to a province or provinces; having the manners, viewpoints, etc., considered characteristic of unsophisticated inhabitants of a province; narrow-minded.

words.tr: n. 心理学家；心理学研究者；
words.ex: The psychologist helped the child feel less afraid.
words.ex_cn: 心理学家帮助孩子感觉不那么害怕。
words.en: A psychologist is a person who studies the human mind and human emotions and behaviour, and who uses this knowledge to help people with mental health problems.

words.ex: The publisher released a new book last month.
words.ex_cn: 出版者上个月发布了一本新书。
words.en: A publisher is a person or company that prepares and issues books, journals, or music for sale.

words.ex: He ran quickly to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跑着去赶公交车。
words.en: In a fast or rapid manner.

words.ex: He walked quietly into the room.
words.ex_cn: 他安静地走进了房间。
words.en: In a manner that does not attract attention; silently or calmly.

words.ex: The children saw a big rainforest on their trip.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在旅行中看到了一片热带雨林。
words.en: A dense, tropical forest that receives a high amount of rainfall, typically located near the equator.

words.ex: The rainstorm came suddenly last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚暴雨突然来了。
words.en: A rainstorm is a storm with heavy rain.

words.ex: He picked a number randomly from the hat.
words.ex_cn: 他从帽子里随机抽了一个数字。
words.en: If something is done randomly, it is done without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.ex: He picked a red raspberry from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一颗红树莓。
words.en: A raspberry is a small, soft red fruit that grows on bushes. It is also used to denote a sound made to express derision or contempt.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: She readily agreed to help me.
words.ex_cn: 她很容易就同意帮我了。
words.en: If you do something readily, you do it in a way which shows that you are very willing to do it.

words.tr: n. 读出；读数；显示的数据
words.ex: The machine shows a readout of the temperature.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器显示了温度的读数。
words.en: A readout is the information produced by a computer or other device, displayed or printed out for the user.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He reconnects his phone to the charger.
words.ex_cn: 他重新把手机连接到充电器。
words.en: To connect again or to establish a new connection after a disconnection.

words.tr: v. 重新考虑；重新审议
words.ex: He must reconsider his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他必须重新考虑他的决定。
words.en: If you reconsider a decision or opinion, you think about it and try to decide whether it should be changed.

words.ex: The movie recreates the battle of Waterloo.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影再现了滑铁卢战役。
words.en: To recreate something means to make it exist or happen again, or to make a copy of something that existed in the past.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.tr: n. 回收利用； v. 再循环；“recycle”的现在分词；
words.ex: Recycling helps reduce waste.
words.ex_cn: 回收利用有助于减少浪费。
words.en: The process of converting waste materials into new materials and objects.

words.tr: n. 沉思；反射；反映；反省；
words.ex: He sat quietly in the garden for reflection.
words.ex_cn: 他静静地坐在花园里沉思。
words.en: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror, glass, or water.

words.ex: He became reflective after reading the old letter.
words.ex_cn: 他读完那封旧信后变得沉思起来。
words.en: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: He went to the registry to register his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他去登记处登记了他的新车。
words.en: A registry is an official list or record of people or things.

words.tr: adv. 定期地；经常地；有规律地；
words.ex: He visits his grandparents regularly.
words.ex_cn: 他定期去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: At consistent intervals or in a consistent manner.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: The company will reintroduce the old product next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将再次推出这款老产品。
words.en: To introduce something again, especially a bill in a legislative assembly.

words.tr: adj. 相关的；有联系的； v. 关联；“relate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This book is related to science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书与科学相关。
words.en: If two or more things are related, there is a connection between them.

words.ex: This room is relatively small.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间相对较小。
words.en: In comparison with other similar things or with what you expect.

words.tr: adj. 令人放松的；轻松的； v. 放松；“relax”的现在分词；
words.ex: The music is relaxing.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐令人放松。
words.en: Making you feel less worried or tense; helping you to rest and become less stiff.

words.tr: adj. 感到宽慰的； v. 缓解；“relieve”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt relieved when he passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 当他通过考试时，他感到宽慰。
words.en: If you are relieved, you feel happy because something unpleasant has not happened or is no longer happening.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.tr:
v. 剩下；留下；依然不变；
n. 遗迹；残余；遗体；
words.ex: Only two cookies remains on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌上只剩下两块饼干了。
words.en: The parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed.

words.tr: v. 移开；消除；开除；“remove”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 离开的；隔代的；
words.ex: He removed the book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他把书从架子上移开了。
words.en: If you say that someone is removed from a situation, you mean that they are not involved in it or affected by it.

words.ex: The renewal of the contract took one week.
words.ex_cn: 合同的更新花了一周时间。
words.en: The act of making something valid for a further period of time after it has expired or been canceled.

words.ex: He repeatedly asked for help.
words.ex_cn: 他再三地请求帮助。
words.en: If something is done repeatedly, it is done again and again.

words.ex: The researcher studies how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这位研究人员研究植物是如何生长的。
words.en: A researcher is someone who conducts research, especially as a job.

words.ex: The reservoir provides water for the nearby town.
words.ex_cn: 这个水库为附近的城镇提供水源。
words.en: A reservoir is a large quantity of a substance that is stored and can be used when needed.

words.ex: He reset the password to log in again.
words.ex_cn: 他重置了密码以便再次登录。
words.en: To set again or differently; to adjust or fix in a new or different way.

words.tr:
n. 度假胜地；手段；
v. 求助于；
words.ex: They went to a beach resort for their vacation.
words.ex_cn: 他们去一个海滨度假胜地度假。
words.en: If you resort to a particular course of action, you do it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

words.tr: adj. 尊重人的；表示敬意的
words.ex: He is always respectful to his teachers.
words.ex_cn: 他总是对老师很尊敬。
words.en: If you are respectful, you show respect for someone.

words.ex: Tom and Jerry scored 80 and 90 points, respectively.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆和杰里分别得了80分和90分。
words.en: Respectively is used to indicate that the items in a list correspond to the items in another list in the same order.

words.ex: The quiet park is restful after a long day.
words.ex_cn: 漫长的一天后，安静的公园有助于休息。
words.en: A restful place or period of time is one that is peaceful and allows you to relax.

words.ex: The retiree walks his dog every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位退休人员每天早上遛狗。
words.en: A retiree is a person who has retired from their job, usually because of age.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: The king's riches came from gold and land.
words.ex_cn: 国王的财富来自黄金和土地。
words.en: Riches refer to a large amount of money or valuable possessions.

words.ex: It's risky to walk alone at night.
words.ex_cn: 晚上独自走路是危险的。
words.en: If an activity or action is risky, it is dangerous or likely to fail.

words.ex: He is roasting marshmallows over the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他正在火上烘烤棉花糖。
words.en: The act of cooking food by dry heat in an oven or over a fire.

words.ex: The children are playing on the rooftop.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在屋顶上玩耍。
words.en: The top covering of a building, including the material or construction of which it is made.

words.tr: adj. 根深蒂固的；生根的； v. 生根；“root”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: His beliefs are rooted in tradition.
words.ex_cn: 他的信念根深蒂固于传统。
words.en: If something is rooted in a particular emotion, belief, or idea, it is strongly influenced by it or developed from it.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: There are roughly 100 students in the class.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级大约有100名学生。
words.en: In a manner that is not exact or detailed; approximately.

words.ex: He bought a round trip ticket to New York.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一张去纽约的往返票。
words.en: A round trip is a journey to a place and back again.

words.ex: The news saddened her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她感到悲伤。
words.en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

words.tr: adv. 妥善保管地；安全地；稳妥地；安全地；
words.ex: She safely stored her jewelry in a safe.
words.ex_cn: 她妥善保管地把珠宝存放在保险箱里。
words.en: In a way that is not likely to cause harm or damage; securely.

words.ex: The salesclerk helped the customer find the right size.
words.ex_cn: 售货员帮助顾客找到了合适的尺码。
words.en: A salesclerk is a person whose job is to serve customers in a store.

words.tr: adj. 满意的；满足的； v. 使满意；使满足；“satisfy”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was satisfied with the result.
words.ex_cn: 他对结果感到满意。
words.en: If you are satisfied with something, you are happy because you have got what you wanted or needed.

words.ex: The dark forest looks scary at night.
words.ex_cn: 这个黑暗的森林在晚上看起来吓人。
words.en: If something is scary, it causes fear or alarm.

words.ex: The wind scatter the leaves everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 风把树叶吹得四处分散。
words.en: To scatter means to throw or drop things over a wide area in an irregular way, or to cause a group of people or animals to move apart in different directions.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.tr:
adj. 安排好时间的
v. 安排；“schedule”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The meeting is scheduled for 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议安排在下午三点。
words.en: If something is scheduled, it is planned to happen at a particular time.

words.ex: He finished his schooling at age 18.
words.ex_cn: 他18岁时完成了学业。
words.en: Schooling is the education that a person receives at school.

words.ex: The children were playing in the schoolyard during recess.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在课间休息时在校园里玩耍。
words.en: The area of land around a school where children can play.

words.ex: The seaman sailed the boat across the sea.
words.ex_cn: 水手驾船横渡大海。
words.en: A seaman is a sailor, especially one who is not an officer.

words.tr: n. 寻求者；追求者；搜索者
words.ex: The seeker found a hidden path in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这位寻找者在森林里发现了一条隐蔽的小路。
words.en: Someone who is trying to find or obtain something.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.tr: adj. 选择性的；精挑细选的；
words.ex: He is selective about what he eats.
words.ex_cn: 他对吃的东西很挑剔。
words.en: If you are selective, you choose things carefully, for example, the things that you buy or do.

words.ex: Self-reflection is an important part of personal growth.
words.ex_cn: 反省是个人成长的重要部分。
words.en: The process of examining one's own thoughts, feelings, and actions to gain insight and understanding.

words.ex: The seller gave me a receipt.
words.ex_cn: 卖方给了我一张收据。
words.en: A seller is a person or organization that sells something.

words.ex: The senator speaks to the people every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员每周都对人民讲话。
words.en: A senator is a member of a senate, which is a governing body in many countries, especially in the United States.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.tr: n. 服务员；侍者；发球员；上菜用具
words.ex: The server brought us water and menus.
words.ex_cn: 服务员给我们端来了水和菜单。
words.en: A server is a computer or a device on a network that manages network resources. Servers are often dedicated, meaning that they perform no other tasks besides their server tasks.

words.ex: He is allergic to shellfish.
words.ex_cn: 他对贝类过敏。
words.en: Shellfish are sea creatures that live in shells and are eaten as food.

words.tr: adj. 遮蔽的；受庇护的；受保护的； v. 庇护；遮蔽；“shelter”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The children played in a sheltered garden.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在一处遮蔽的花园里玩耍。
words.en: Protected from the harsh realities of life; not exposed to difficulties or unpleasantness.

words.tr: v. 放于架上；搁置；倾斜
words.ex: He will shelve the book on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他将把书放在书架上。
words.en: To shelve something means to decide not to continue with a plan or project, often because it is not possible or practical at the present time.

words.tr: adj. 光亮的；闪耀的；锃亮的；有光泽的；
words.ex: The shiny coin caught her eye.
words.ex_cn: 那枚光亮的硬币引起了她的注意。
words.en: Something that is shiny has a bright, smooth surface that reflects light.

words.tr:
n. 展示优点的场合（或机会）；
v. 展示…的优点；
words.ex: The competition was a showcase for her talent.
words.ex_cn: 这次比赛是她展示才华的机会。
words.en: A showcase is a setting in which someone or something is displayed to its best advantage, or a glass case used for displaying articles in a shop or museum.

words.ex: She wore a showy dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件显眼的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is showy is very noticeable because it is large, colorful, or exaggerated.

words.tr: n. 看见； v. “sight”的现在分词；
words.ex: The sighting of a rare bird excited the birdwatchers.
words.ex_cn: 看到一只稀有鸟类让观鸟者兴奋不已。
words.en: The act of seeing or noticing someone or something, especially something unusual or unexpected.

words.tr: adv. 极大地；值得注目地；
words.ex: The new policy significantly improved student performance.
words.ex_cn: 新政策极大地改善了学生的成绩。
words.en: In a way that is large or important enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He left the room silently.
words.ex_cn: 他默默地离开了房间。
words.en: Without making any sound; quietly.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: He simply wants to go home.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想回家。
words.en: In a simple manner; without much complexity or difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 位于…的；处于…的境地的； v. 使位于；使坐落于；“situate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is situated near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于湖边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.ex: He is a skilled carpenter.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名有技能的木匠。
words.en: Having the ability and experience to do something well.

words.tr: adj. 皮包骨头的；极瘦的；
words.ex: The skinny dog had no meat on its bones.
words.ex_cn: 那只皮包骨头的狗身上一点肉都没有。
words.en: Very thin, especially in a way that is unattractive.

words.ex: The children rode a sled down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐着雪橇从积雪的山坡滑下。
words.en: A sled is a vehicle used for traveling over snow and ice, typically consisting of a light frame mounted on runners and often used for recreation or transporting goods.

words.tr: adj. （食物）已切成薄片的; v. 切成薄片；分配（slice 的过去式和过去分词）
words.ex: He ate sliced apples for snack.
words.ex_cn: 他吃切片苹果当点心。
words.en: Cut into slices.

words.ex: He walks slowly to enjoy the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他慢慢地走，以便欣赏日落。
words.en: If you do something slowly, you do it at a low speed.

words.ex: He uses a smartphone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用智能手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that can perform many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touchscreen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded applications.

words.ex: The smelly trash made everyone cover their noses.
words.ex_cn: 那堆难闻的垃圾让每个人都捂住了鼻子。
words.en: Having a strong, unpleasant smell.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: The spacecraft landed safely on Mars.
words.ex_cn: 航天器在火星上安全着陆。
words.en: A spacecraft is a vehicle or machine designed to fly in outer space. Spacecraft are used for a variety of purposes, including communications, Earth observation, meteorology, navigation, space colonization, planetary exploration, and transportation of humans and cargo.

words.tr:
n. 西班牙语；
adj. 西班牙的；西班牙语的；
words.ex: He speaks spanish fluently.
words.ex_cn: 他流利地讲西班牙语。
words.en: Of or relating to Spain, its people, or its language.

words.ex: He has good spatial skills for drawing maps.
words.ex_cn: 他画地图有很好的空间能力。
words.en: Relating to or occupying space.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.ex: Can you tell me the specifics of the plan?
words.ex_cn: 你能告诉我这个计划的细节吗？
words.en: The specifics of something are the particular details of it.

words.tr: adj. 无言以对的；一时语塞的
words.ex: He was speechless when he saw the gift.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到礼物时，他哑口无言。
words.en: If you are speechless, you are temporarily unable to speak, usually because something has shocked or surprised you.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.tr: v. “stand”的现在分词；站立； adj. 直立的；常设的； n. 地位；
words.ex: He is standing by the door.
words.ex_cn: 他正站在门边。
words.en: Your standing is your status or reputation.

words.tr: adj. 庄重的；庄严的；堂皇的；
words.ex: The stately mansion stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 那座庄重的豪宅矗立在山上。
words.en: Something that is stately is impressive because of its size, beauty, or grandeur.

words.ex: The car remained static at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在红灯前静止不动。
words.en: Something that is static does not move or change.

words.ex: The house has three storeys.
words.ex_cn: 这栋房子有三层。
words.en: A storey is a level of a building; a floor.

words.ex: The old man is a good storyteller.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人是个出色的故事讲述者。
words.en: A storyteller is someone who tells or writes stories.

words.tr: adj. 有压力的；紧张的； v. 强调；“stress”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt stressed before the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他在考试前感到有压力。
words.en: If you are stressed, you feel tense and anxious because of difficulties in your life.

words.tr: adj. 卡住的；受困的； v. 粘贴；“stick”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The door is stuck and won't open.
words.ex_cn: 门卡住了，打不开。
words.en: If something is stuck in a particular position, it is fixed tightly in this position and is unable to move.

words.ex: He had a stumble on the rocky path.
words.ex_cn: 他在布满石头的小路上绊了一跤。
words.en: To stumble means to trip or momentarily lose one's balance while walking or running. It can also refer to speaking in a hesitant or faltering manner.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.ex: Suddenly, the light went out.
words.ex_cn: 突然，灯灭了。
words.en: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

words.tr: adj. 适合的；合适的； v. 适合；“suit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: This job is suited for someone who loves quiet work.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作适合喜欢安静工作的人。
words.en: If someone or something is suited to a particular purpose, they have the right qualities or characteristics for it.

words.tr:
n. 日灼；晒伤
v. 晒黑；晒伤
words.ex: He got sunburn after swimming all day.
words.ex_cn: 他整天游泳后得了日灼。
words.en: Sunburn is a condition where the skin becomes red, sore, and sometimes swollen and blistered as a result of overexposure to the ultraviolet rays of the sun.

words.ex: We woke up early to see the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 我们早起看日出。
words.en: The time in the morning when the sun appears or full daylight arrives.

words.ex: We watched the sunset by the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们在海滩上看了夕阳。
words.en: The time in the evening when the sun disappears or daylight fades.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.ex: The supplier delivered the boxes on time.
words.ex_cn: 供应商按时送来了箱子。
words.en: A supplier is a person or company that provides goods or services to another person or company.

words.ex: He is supposedly coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 据推测他明天来。
words.en: If you say that something is supposedly the case, you mean that people say it is the case but you do not think it is necessarily true.

words.tr: adj. 令人吃惊的；出人意料的； v. “surprise”的现在分词；
words.ex: It was surprising that he passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，这令人吃惊。
words.en: Causing surprise; unexpected.

words.ex: He looked at her with suspicion.
words.ex_cn: 他带着怀疑的眼神看着她。
words.en: A feeling or thought that something is possible, likely, or true, especially something bad or wrong, without having proof.

words.tr:
v. 摇摆；摇动；
n. 影响；支配；
words.ex: The tree branches sway in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树的枝条在风中摇摆。
words.en: To sway means to move slowly or rhythmically backwards and forwards or from side to side. It can also mean to influence someone or something.

words.tr: n. 外卖餐馆；外卖食物；
words.ex: We ordered dinner from the Chinese takeaway.
words.ex_cn: 我们从一家中餐外卖店点了晚餐。
words.en: A takeaway is a main point or piece of information that you learn from something such as a meeting, discussion, or document.

words.tr: n. 驯兽师； adj. “tame”的比较级；
words.ex: The tamer walks the lion into the cage.
words.ex_cn: 驯兽师把狮子牵进笼子。
words.en: A tamer is someone who trains wild animals, especially for performance in a circus.

words.tr: adj. 缠结的； v. “tangle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The hair was tangled after the wind.
words.ex_cn: 头发被风吹得打结了。
words.en: If something is tangled, it is twisted together untidily and is difficult to unravel or separate.

words.ex: This school has technological labs for students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校为学生配备了科技实验室。
words.en: Technological means relating to or involving technology.

words.tr: adj. 青少年的；十来岁的；
words.ex: Teenage boys often like playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 青少年男孩通常喜欢打篮球。
words.en: Teenage is used to describe someone who is between the ages of 13 and 19, or something that is related to or typical of this age group.

words.ex: I am terribly sorry for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 我为这个错误非常抱歉。
words.en: Used to emphasize the extreme degree of something.

words.ex: The store sells many kinds of textile, like cotton and silk.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店出售多种纺织品，比如棉和丝绸。
words.en: Textiles are types of cloth or fabric, especially ones that have been woven.

words.ex: We eat turkey on Thanksgiving.
words.ex_cn: 我们在感恩节吃火鸡。
words.en: Thanksgiving is a national holiday celebrated primarily in the United States and Canada as a day of giving thanks for the blessing of the harvest and of the preceding year.

words.ex: We went to the theater to watch a play.
words.ex_cn: 我们去剧院看了一场话剧。
words.en: A theater is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He gave a thoughtful answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个深思的答案。
words.en: If you are thoughtful, you are quiet and serious because you are thinking about something.

words.tr: adj. 非常兴奋的；极为激动的； v. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was thrilled when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他非常兴奋。
words.en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

words.tr:
adj. 惊险的； 令人激动的
v. 激动；震颤；兴奋；“thrill”的现在分词
words.ex: The roller coaster ride was thrilling.
words.ex_cn: 过山车之旅令人激动。
words.en: If something is thrilling, it causes a sudden feeling of great excitement, enjoyment, or sometimes fear.

words.ex: The teacher gave timely help when I was stuck.
words.ex_cn: 当我遇到困难时，老师及时提供了帮助。
words.en: done or occurring at a favorable or useful time; opportune.

words.tr: v. 触摸；接触；“touch”的现在分词；
words.ex: The child is touching the soft blanket.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在触摸柔软的毯子。
words.en: If something is touching, it causes feelings of sadness or sympathy.

words.ex: The transformation of the old factory into a park made the city nicer.
words.ex_cn: 把旧工厂改造成公园让城市变得更美了。
words.en: A transformation is a complete change in the appearance, form, or nature of something or someone.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: The signal transmission is clear and strong.
words.ex_cn: 信号传输清晰而强劲。
words.en: The act or process of sending or passing something from one place, person, or thing to another.

words.tr: n. 垃圾；无价值的东西；
words.ex: The trash bin is full.
words.ex_cn: 垃圾桶满了。
words.en: Waste material or unwanted things that are thrown away.

words.ex: The treasury decided to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 财政部决定降低税收。
words.en: The treasury is the department within a government that manages its finances, including the collection of taxes and the allocation of funds.

words.ex: This puzzle is tricky for kids.
words.ex_cn: 这个谜题对孩子来说很棘手。
words.en: If you describe a task or problem as tricky, you mean that it is difficult to deal with and requires careful thinking or skill.

words.tr:
n. 用力拉；拖拽；拖船
v. 用力拉；使劲拖；拖拽
words.ex: He gave a strong tug on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用力拉了绳子一下。
words.en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.

words.ex: The tuition for this course is $500.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程的学费是500美元。
words.en: Tuition is the fee charged for instruction, especially at a college, university, or private school.

words.ex: The train went through a long tunnel.
words.ex_cn: 火车通过了一条长长的隧道。
words.en: A tunnel is a long passage which has been made under or through the ground, usually through a hill or under a river, to allow people or vehicles to travel through it.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.ex: It is uncommon to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不常见的。
words.en: If you describe something as uncommon, you mean that it does not happen often or is not often seen.

words.ex: He underestimated the difficulty of the test.
words.ex_cn: 他低估了考试的难度。
words.en: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large, great, or serious it is.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr: n. 理解；了解； v. “understand”的现在分词；
words.ex: His understanding of the problem helped solve it quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的理解帮助快速解决了它。
words.en: An understanding is a mutual agreement or sympathy between people or groups.

words.ex: He will undertake a new project next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将从事一个新项目。
words.en: To undertake a task or job means to start doing it and accept responsibility for it.

words.tr:
n. 解开；祸根；毁灭的原因
v. 解开；撤消；毁掉；“undo”的现在分词
words.ex: The undoing of the knot took only a few seconds.
words.ex_cn: 解开这个结只花了几秒钟。
words.en: The act of causing someone's failure or ruin.

words.tr: adj. 失业的；待业的；下岗的；
words.ex: He is unemployed after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业了，因为失去了工作。
words.en: If someone is unemployed, they do not have a job.

words.tr: adj. 想不到的；意料之外的；
words.ex: The rain was unexpected.
words.ex_cn: 这场雨是意想不到的。
words.en: If an event or someone's behaviour is unexpected, it surprises you because you were not expecting it to happen or because you did not think that person would behave in that way.

words.ex: The town looked unfamiliar to him.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇对他来说很陌生。
words.en: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

words.ex: He unfolded the map on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把地图在桌子上展开。
words.en: To open or spread out something that is folded; to develop or be revealed.

words.ex: Unfortunately, he missed the bus.
words.ex_cn: 不幸的是，他错过了公交车。
words.en: Used to say that something is sad, disappointing, or has a bad effect.

words.ex: The neighbor gave an unfriendly look.
words.ex_cn: 邻居给了一个不友好的眼神。
words.en: If you describe someone as unfriendly, you mean that they behave in a hostile or unsympathetic way.

words.tr: adj. 难以置信的；不可想象的；
words.ex: The damage from the storm was unimaginable.
words.ex_cn: 风暴造成的破坏难以置信。
words.en: If you describe something as unimaginable, you are emphasizing that it is difficult to imagine or understand because it is not part of people's normal experience.

words.ex: This rule is universally accepted.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则被普遍接受。
words.en: In a way that is done or shared by all people or things in the world or in a particular group.

words.tr:
adj. 未知的；不为人知的；
n. 未知的地方（或事物）；
words.ex: The unknown cause of the accident is being investigated.
words.ex_cn: 事故的未知原因正在调查中。
words.en: If something is unknown, it is not known or recognized by people.

words.tr: adj. 无限制的；无限量的；
words.ex: He has unlimited access to the library.
words.ex_cn: 他可以无限制地使用图书馆。
words.en: If something is unlimited, there is no limit to it.

words.ex: The unmanned drone flew over the field.
words.ex_cn: 这架无人驾驶的无人机飞过了田野。
words.en: An unmanned vehicle or machine is one that operates without a person inside it or controlling it.

words.ex: He unpacks his bags after arriving home.
words.ex_cn: 他到家后打开行李。
words.en: To unpack means to open and remove the contents of a container, such as a suitcase or a box, or to explain or analyze something in detail.

words.ex: The smell was unpleasant.
words.ex_cn: 这气味令人不快。
words.en: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example, by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

words.ex: He was unsuccessful in finding a job.
words.ex_cn: 他找工作没有成功。
words.en: Not achieving the desired results; not successful.

words.ex: He felt unworthy of the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他觉得自己不配得到这个奖。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unworthy of something, you mean that they do not deserve it.

words.ex: The upside of working late is more money.
words.ex_cn: 加班的好处是能赚更多钱。
words.en: The upside is the more positive aspect of a situation that is generally bad.

words.ex: The desert has little vegetation.
words.ex_cn: 这个沙漠植被很少。
words.en: Vegetation refers to plants in general, or the plants that are found in a particular area. It can also refer to a life that is dull or inactive, often due to illness or lack of exercise.

words.tr:
n. 冒险事业；商业冒险；投机；
v. 冒险；投机；
words.ex: He started a new venture in technology.
words.ex_cn: 他创办了一项新的科技冒险事业。
words.en: If you venture somewhere, you go somewhere that might be dangerous. If you venture a question or statement, you say it in an uncertain way because you are afraid it might be stupid or wrong.

words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs', 'runs' is a verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She runs' 中，'runs' 是一个动词。
words.en: A word that is used to describe an action, state, or occurrence, and forming the main part of the predicate of a sentence, such as 'run', 'become', or 'happen'.

words.ex: He traveled to Vietnam last summer.
words.ex_cn: 他去年夏天去了越南。
words.en: Vietnam is a country in Southeast Asia, known for its beaches, rivers, Buddhist pagodas, and bustling cities.

words.ex: The viewer watched the movie on TV.
words.ex_cn: 观看者在电视上看了这部电影。
words.en: A viewer is someone who watches something, especially television.

words.ex: The show increased its viewership last month.
words.ex_cn: 这个节目上个月的观众人数增加了。
words.en: The number of people who watch a particular television programme or channel.

words.tr: adv. 激烈地；猛烈地；凶狠地
words.ex: He was violently shaking during the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他在风暴中剧烈地颤抖。
words.en: In a way that involves physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something.

words.ex: Eating fruits gives you vitamin C.
words.ex_cn: 吃水果可以给你维生素C。
words.en: A vitamin is one of a group of organic substances which are essential in small quantities to the nutrition of most animals and some plants, and which are present in natural foodstuffs or sometimes produced within the body.

words.ex: The alcohol is volatile and evaporates quickly.
words.ex_cn: 酒精是易挥发的，会迅速蒸发。
words.en: A volatile situation or person is one that is likely to change suddenly and unexpectedly, especially by getting worse.

words.ex: They went on a long voyage across the ocean.
words.ex_cn: 他们进行了一次横跨海洋的长途航行。
words.en: A voyage is a long journey, especially by sea or in space.

words.ex: They bought new wallpaper for the bedroom.
words.ex_cn: 他们为卧室买了新壁纸。
words.en: Wallpaper is a material used to cover and decorate the interior walls of homes, offices, and other buildings; it is usually sold in rolls and is applied onto the wall using wallpaper paste.

words.ex: The waterfall makes a loud sound.
words.ex_cn: 瀑布发出很大的声音。
words.en: A waterfall is a place where water flows over the edge of a steep, high cliff in hills or mountains, and falls into a pool below.

words.ex: The boat travels on the waterway.
words.ex_cn: 船在水道上行驶。
words.en: A waterway is a river, canal, or other route for travel by water.

words.ex: The soup was too watery and tasted bland.
words.ex_cn: 这汤太稀了，味道淡。
words.en: Something that is watery contains, resembles, or consists of water.

words.tr: adj. 众所周知的；著名的
words.ex: He is a well-known singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: A well-known person, place, or thing is one that is known about by a lot of people.

words.ex: He is a well-rounded student who likes sports, music, and math.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个全面发展的好学生，喜欢运动、音乐和数学。
words.en: If you describe someone as well-rounded, you mean that they have a personality which is fully developed in all aspects.

words.ex: The wetland is home to many birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片湿地是许多鸟类的家园。
words.en: Wetlands are areas where water covers the soil, or is present either at or near the surface of the soil all year or for varying periods of time during the year, including during the growing season.

words.ex: He uses a wheelchair to move around.
words.ex_cn: 他使用轮椅来移动。
words.en: A wheelchair is a chair with wheels, used by people who cannot walk because of illness, injury, or disability.

words.tr:
n. 鞭子
v. 鞭打；抽打；突然移动
words.ex: The farmer used a whip to guide the horse.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用鞭子赶马。
words.en: To whip means to hit a person or animal with a whip, or to move something quickly and suddenly.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.ex: The hikers got lost in the wilderness.
words.ex_cn: 徒步旅行者在荒野中迷路了。
words.en: A wilderness is a wild and uncultivated region, as of forest or desert, uninhabited or inhabited only by wild animals.

words.ex: He lost weight by using his willpower.
words.ex_cn: 他凭借意志力减掉了体重。
words.en: Willpower is the ability to control yourself and to make yourself do things that are difficult or unpleasant.

words.ex: He works at a small winery near the hills.
words.ex_cn: 他在山边的一家小酒庄工作。
words.en: A winery is a place where wine is made, often including vineyards where the grapes are grown.

words.tr: n. 胜利；赢得（物）； adj. 获胜的；赢的； v. 赢；获得；“win”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her winning was celebrated by the whole team.
words.ex_cn: 她的胜利得到了全队的庆祝。
words.en: A winning person or thing is one that wins or has won something, such as a competition, game, or election.

words.ex: The child looked at the stars with wonderment.
words.ex_cn: 孩子带着惊奇望着星空。
words.en: A feeling of surprise and admiration, caused by something beautiful, unexpected, unfamiliar, or inexplicable.

words.ex: He sat on a wooden chair.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在一张木制椅子上。
words.en: Made of wood; lacking ease or grace.

words.ex: This plan is workable and cheap.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的，而且便宜。
words.en: If something is workable, it can be done, used, or put into operation successfully.

words.tr: v. 工作；劳动；“work”的现在分词； adj. 工作的；劳动的；
words.ex: He is working in a factory.
words.ex_cn: 他正在工厂工作。
words.en: Engaged in work, especially as one's regular occupation; functioning or able to function.

words.ex: He does a daily workout at the gym.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在健身房健身。
words.en: A session of vigorous physical exercise or training.

words.ex: We attended a workshop on writing skills.
words.ex_cn: 我们参加了一个关于写作技巧的研讨会。
words.en: A workshop is a room or building where things are made or repaired using tools or machinery. It can also refer to a meeting at which a group of people engage in intensive discussion and activity on a particular subject or project.

words.tr: v. “write”的过去分词；写作；书写； adj. 书面的；
words.ex: The letter was written by hand.
words.ex_cn: 这封信是手写的。
words.en: Something that is written has been recorded in writing rather than spoken.

words.tr:
adj. 每年的；
adv. 每年地；
words.ex: He pays his rent yearly.
words.ex_cn: 他每年支付一次房租。
words.en: Happening or done once a year or every year.

words.ex: He has a youthful smile.
words.ex_cn: 他有着年轻的笑容。
words.en: Someone who is youthful behaves or looks as if they are young.

words.ex: The zookeeper feeds the lions every morning.
words.ex_cn: 饲养员每天早上给狮子喂食。
words.en: A zookeeper is a person who manages and takes care of the animals in a zoo.

words.ex: The zoo has a zoological garden for rare animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个动物园有一个动物学花园，用于展示稀有动物。
words.en: Relating to the scientific study of animals.
